verses.1:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of testimony, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.1:2: "Take the sum of the whole congregation of Israel by kinship groups, by houses of ancestral families, by number, by name, head by head among them;
verses.1:3: every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army of Israel, muster them with their army; you and Aaron, muster them.
verses.1:4: And with you shall be each man by the tribe of each of the leaders, and they shall be by houses of ancestral families.
verses.1:5: And these are the names of the men who will stand with you: from the sons of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
verses.1:6: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
verses.1:7: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
verses.1:8: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
verses.1:9: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon; from the sons of Joseph, from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud,
verses.1:10: from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
verses.1:11: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
verses.1:12: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
verses.1:13: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ochran;
verses.1:14: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Reuel;
verses.1:15: from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan."
verses.1:16: These are the summoned ones of the congregation, leaders of the tribes by ancestral families, commanders of thousands of Israel.
verses.1:17: And Moses and Aaron took these men who were called by name,
verses.1:18: and they assembled the whole congregation on the first day of the month of the second year, and they registered them by their lineages, by their ancestral families, by the number of their names, from twenty years old and upward, every male, head by head among them,
verses.1:19: just as the Lord directed Moses. And they were mustered in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.1:20: And the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:21: their mustering from the tribe of Reuben was forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.1:22: For the sons of Simeon, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:23: their muster from the tribe of Simeon was fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.1:24: For the sons of Judah, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:25: their muster from the tribe of Judah was seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.1:26: For the sons of Issachar, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:27: their muster from the tribe of Issachar was fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.1:28: For the sons of Zebulun, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:29: their muster from the tribe of Zebulun was fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.1:30: For the sons of Joseph, the sons of Ephraim, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:31: their muster from the tribe of Ephraim was forty thousand five hundred.
verses.1:32: For the sons of Manasseh, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:33: their muster from the tribe of Manasseh was thirty-two thousand three hundred.
verses.1:34: For the sons of Benjamin, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:35: their muster from the tribe of Benjamin was thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.1:36: For the sons of Gad, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:37: their muster from the tribe of Gad was forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.1:38: For the sons of Dan, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:39: their muster from the tribe of Dan was sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.1:40: For the sons of Asher, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:41: their muster from the tribe of Asher was forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.1:42: For the sons of Naphtali, by their kinship groups, by their clans, by the houses of their ancestral families, by the number of their names, head by head among them, all males from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out in the army:
verses.1:43: their muster from the tribe of Naphtali was fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.1:44: This is the muster that Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel conducted, twelve men; they were one man for each tribe, by the tribe of the houses of an ancestral family.
verses.1:45: And the whole muster of the sons of Israel in their army, from twenty years old and upward, everyone going out to draw up for battle in Israel, came to
verses.1:46: six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.1:47: But the Levites from the tribe of their ancestral family were not mustered among the sons of Israel.
verses.1:48: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.1:49: "See, you shall not include the tribe of Levi in the muster, and you shall not take their number in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.1:50: And you, appoint the Levites over the tent of testimony and over all its furnishings and over all that is in it. They shall carry the tent and all its furnishings, and they shall minister in it, and they shall encamp around the tent.
verses.1:51: And when the tent is to set out, the Levites shall take it down, and when the tent is to encamp, they shall set it up; and the outsider who comes near must die.
verses.1:52: And the sons of Israel shall encamp, each man in his own rank and each man according to his own command, with their army;
verses.1:53: but let the Levites encamp before the Lord around the tent of testimony, and there will be no sin among the sons of Israel. And the Levites themselves shall keep the watch of the tent of testimony."
verses.1:54: And the sons of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron; so they did.
verses.2:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.2:2: "Let the sons of Israel encamp, each man next to him, by division, by standards, by the houses of their fathers; the sons of Israel will encamp facing all around the tent of testimony.
verses.2:3: And those who encamp toward the south, toward the east are the division of the camp of Judah with their force, and the leader of the sons of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.
verses.2:4: His force, those who were registered, is seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.2:5: And those who encamp next are of the tribe of Issachar, and the leader of the sons of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.
verses.2:6: His force, those who were registered, is fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.2:7: And those who encamp next are of the tribe of Zebulun, and the leader of the sons of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.
verses.2:8: Their force, those who were registered, is fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.2:9: All those who were registered from the camp of Judah are one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, with their force; they will set out first.
verses.2:10: The division of the camp of Reuben: toward the south is their force, and the leader of the sons of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.2:11: His force, those who were registered, is forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.2:12: And those who encamp next to him are of the tribe of Simeon, and the leader of the sons of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
verses.2:13: His force, those who were registered, is fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.2:14: And those who encamp next to him are the tribe of Gad, and the leader of the sons of Gad is Eliasaph son of Reuel.
verses.2:15: His force, those who were registered, is forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.2:16: All those who were registered from the camp of Reuben are one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, with their force; they will set out second.
verses.2:17: And the tent of testimony will be lifted up, and the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps; just as they encamp, so also they will set out, each one next in order according to leadership.
verses.2:18: The division of the camp of Ephraim is by the sea with their force, and the leader of the sons of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.
verses.2:19: His force, those who were registered, is forty thousand five hundred.
verses.2:20: And those who encamp next are of the tribe of Manasseh, and the leader of the sons of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
verses.2:21: His force, those who were registered, is thirty-two thousand four hundred.
verses.2:22: And those who encamp next are of the tribe of Benjamin, and the leader of the sons of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.2:23: His force, those who were registered, is thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.2:24: All those who were registered of the camp of Ephraim are one hundred eight thousand one hundred, with their force; they will set out third.
verses.2:25: The division of the camp of Dan is toward the north with their force, and the leader of the sons of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
verses.2:26: His force, those who were registered, is sixty-two thousand five hundred.
verses.2:27: And those who encamp next to him are of the tribe of Asher, and the leader of the sons of Asher is Pagiel son of Ochran.
verses.2:28: His force, those who were registered, is forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.2:29: And those who encamp next are of the tribe of Naphtali, and the leader of the sons of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.
verses.2:30: His force, those who were registered, is fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.2:31: All those who were registered of the camp of Dan are one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred; they will set out last by their division."
verses.2:32: This is the registration of the sons of Israel by the houses of their fathers; the entire registration of the camps with their forces is six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.2:33: But the Levites were not registered together among them, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.2:34: And the sons of Israel did all that the Lord ordered Moses; so they encamped by their division, and so they set out, each one next in order by their clans, by the houses of their fathers.
verses.3:1: And these are the generations of Aaron and Moses on the day when the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.3:2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: the firstborn, Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.3:3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whose hands they consecrated to serve as priests.
verses.3:4: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord while they were offering strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children; and Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with Aaron their father.
verses.3:5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:6: "Take the tribe of Levi, and you shall set them before Aaron the priest, and they shall minister to him.
verses.3:7: And they shall keep his charges and the charges of the sons of Israel before the tent of testimony, to perform the works of the tent;
verses.3:8: and they shall keep all the articles of the tent of testimony and the charges of the sons of Israel, according to all the works of the tent.
verses.3:9: And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons the priests; these are given as a gift to Me from the sons of Israel.
verses.3:10: And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons over the tent of testimony, and they shall keep their priesthood and all things pertaining to the altar and inside the curtain; and the outsider who touches it shall die."
verses.3:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:12: "And look, I have taken the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn who opens the womb from the sons of Israel; they shall be their ransom, and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.3:13: For every firstborn is Mine; on the day when I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified to Myself every firstborn in Israel; from man to livestock, they shall be Mine; I am the Lord."
verses.3:14: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.3:15: "Enroll the sons of Levi according to their fathers' houses, according to their clans; every male from a month old and upward, enroll them."
verses.3:16: And Moses and Aaron enrolled them by the voice of the Lord, just as the Lord directed them.
verses.3:17: And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.3:18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon according to their clans: Libni and Shimei.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Kohath according to their clans: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.3:20: And the sons of Merari according to their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
verses.3:21: To Gershon belonged the clan of Libni and the clan of Shimei; these are the clans of Gershon.
verses.3:22: Their enrollment according to the number of every male from a month old and upward, their enrollment was seven thousand five hundred.
verses.3:23: And the sons of Gershon shall encamp behind the tent toward the sea;
verses.3:24: and the leader of the father's house of the clan of Gershon was Eliasaph son of Dael.
verses.3:25: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of testimony was the tent and the covering, and the screen of the door of the tent of testimony,
verses.3:26: and the hangings of the courtyard, and the curtain of the gate of the courtyard that is by the tent, and the remainder of all its works.
verses.3:27: To Kohath belonged the Amramite clan, and the Izharite clan, and the Hebronite clan, and the Uzzielite clan; these are the clans of Kohath according to number,
verses.3:28: every male from a month old and upward, eight thousand six hundred, keeping the charges of the holy things.
verses.3:29: The clans of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the side of the tent toward the south;
verses.3:30: and the leader of the fathers' house of the clans of Kohath was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
verses.3:31: And their charge was the ark and the table and the lampstand and the altars, and the articles of the sanctuary, all those with which they minister, and the screen and all their works.
verses.3:32: And the leader over the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, appointed to keep the charges of the holy things.
verses.3:33: To Merari belonged the Mahlite clan and the Mushite clan; these are the clans of Merari.
verses.3:34: Their enrollment according to number, every male from a month old and upward, was six thousand and fifty;
verses.3:35: and the leader of the father's house of the clan of Merari was Zuriel son of Abihail; they shall encamp on the side of the tent toward the north.
verses.3:36: The oversight, the charge of the sons of Merari was the capitals of the tent and its bars and its pillars and its bases, and all their articles and their works,
verses.3:37: and the pillars of the courtyard all around and their bases, and the pegs and their cords.
verses.3:38: And those who encamp in front of the tent of testimony on the east are Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charges of the sanctuary for the charges of the sons of Israel; and the outsider who touches it shall die.
verses.3:39: The entire enrollment of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron enrolled by the voice of the Lord according to their clans, every male from a month old and upward, was twenty-two thousand.
verses.3:40: And the Lord said to Moses, saying, "Enroll every firstborn male of the sons of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number by name;
verses.3:41: and you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the Lord—in place of all the firstborn of the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the livestock of the sons of Israel."
verses.3:42: And Moses enrolled, just as the Lord commanded, every firstborn among the sons of Israel;
verses.3:43: and all the firstborn males, according to number by name from a month old and upward from their enrollment, came to twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
verses.3:44: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:45: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock, and the Levites shall be Mine; I am the Lord.
verses.3:46: And as for the ransom—the two hundred and seventy-three who are in excess of the Levites from the firstborn of the sons of Israel—
verses.3:47: then you shall take five shekels per head; according to the holy didrachma you shall take them, twenty obols to the shekel;
verses.3:48: and you shall give the silver to Aaron and to his sons as the ransom of those who are in excess among them."
verses.3:49: And Moses took the silver, the ransom of those who were in excess, for the redemption of the Levites;
verses.3:50: from the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the silver, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, according to the holy shekel.
verses.3:51: And Moses gave the ransom of those who were in excess to Aaron and to his sons by the voice of the Lord, just as the Lord directed Moses.
verses.4:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.4:2: "Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from the midst of the sons of Levi, according to their clans, according to their ancestral houses,
verses.4:3: from twenty-five years old and upward, and up to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister, to do all the works in the tent of testimony.
verses.4:4: And these are the works of the sons of Kohath in the tent of testimony: the holy of holies.
verses.4:5: And Aaron and his sons shall go in when the camp sets out, and they shall take down the screening curtain and cover the ark of the testimony with it.
verses.4:6: And they shall place on it a covering of blue leather, and lay over it an all-blue cloth on top, and insert the carrying poles.
verses.4:7: And on the table that is set forth they shall lay an all-purple cloth, and the dishes, and the incense cups, and the ladles, and the libation bowls with which he pours drink offerings; and the continual loaves shall be on it.
verses.4:8: And they shall lay over it a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a blue leather covering, and insert the carrying poles through it.
verses.4:9: And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that gives light, and its lamps, and its tongs, and its oil funnels, and all the oil vessels with which they minister.
verses.4:10: And they shall put it and all its articles into a blue leather covering, and place it on carrying poles.
verses.4:11: And over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a blue leather covering, and insert its carrying poles.
verses.4:12: And they shall take all the articles of ministry with which they minister in the holy place, and put them into a blue cloth, and cover them with a blue leather covering, and place them on carrying poles.
verses.4:13: And he shall place the cover on the altar, and they shall spread an all-purple cloth over it.
verses.4:14: And they shall place on it all the articles with which they minister on it, and the firepans, and the meat forks, and the bowls, and the cover, and all the articles of the altar; and they shall lay over it a blue leather covering, and insert its carrying poles. And they shall take a purple cloth and cover up the washbasin and its base, and put it into a blue leather covering, and place it on carrying poles.
verses.4:15: And Aaron and his sons shall finish covering the holy things and all the holy articles when the camp sets out; and after these things the sons of Kohath shall go in to carry them, and they shall not touch the holy things, so that they will not die. These things the sons of Kohath shall carry in the tent of testimony.
verses.4:16: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest is overseer: the oil of the light, and the compounded incense, and the daily sacrifice, and the anointing oil, the oversight of the whole tent and all that is in it in the holy place, in all the works."
verses.4:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.4:18: "Do not destroy the tribe's clan of Kohath from the midst of the Levites.
verses.4:19: Do this for them, and they shall live and by no means die when they approach the most holy things: let Aaron and his sons approach, and they shall appoint them, each according to his burden.
verses.4:20: And they shall by no means go in to look suddenly at the holy things, or they will die."
verses.4:21: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:22: "Take the total of the sons of Gershon, these also, according to their ancestral houses, according to their clans;
verses.4:23: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old register them, everyone who enters to minister, to do his works in the tent of testimony.
verses.4:24: This is the ministry of the clan of Gershon, to minister and to carry:
verses.4:25: and it shall carry the curtains of the tent, and the tent of testimony and its covering, and the blue covering that is over it on top, and the covering of the doorway of the tent of testimony,
verses.4:26: and the hangings of the courtyard, all that are at the tent of testimony, and the remaining things; and all the articles of ministry with which they minister they shall attend to.
verses.4:27: By the mouth of Aaron and his sons shall be the ministry of the sons of Gershon, according to all their ministries and according to all the works by them; and you shall register them by name for all the things to be carried by them.
verses.4:28: This is the ministry of the sons of Gershon in the tent of testimony, and their charge is in the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.4:29: As for the sons of Merari, according to their clans, according to their ancestral houses, register them;
verses.4:30: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old register them, everyone who enters to minister in the works of the tent of testimony.
verses.4:31: And these are the charges of the things carried by them, according to all the works of the things in the tent of testimony: the capitals of the tent, and the bars, and its pillars, and its bases, and the covering, and their bases, and their pillars, and the covering of the doorway of the tent,
verses.4:32: and the pillars of the courtyard all around, and their bases, and the pillars of the curtain of the gate of the courtyard and their bases, and their pegs, and their cords, and all their articles, and all their ministries; by name register them and all the articles of the charge of the things carried by them.
verses.4:33: This is the ministry of the clan of the sons of Merari in all their works in the tent of testimony, in the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest."
verses.4:34: And Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel registered the sons of Kohath according to their clans, according to their ancestral houses,
verses.4:35: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister and to work in the tent of testimony.
verses.4:36: And their registration according to their clans was two thousand two hundred fifty.
verses.4:37: This is the registration of the clan of Kohath, everyone who ministers in the tent of testimony, just as Moses and Aaron registered them by the voice of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.
verses.4:38: And the sons of Gershon were registered according to their clans, according to their ancestral houses,
verses.4:39: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister and to do the works in the tent of testimony.
verses.4:40: And their registration according to their clans, according to their ancestral houses, was two thousand six hundred thirty.
verses.4:41: This is the registration of the clan of the sons of Gershon, everyone who ministers in the tent of testimony, whom Moses and Aaron registered by the voice of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.
verses.4:42: And the clan of the sons of Merari was also registered according to their clans, according to their ancestral houses,
verses.4:43: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister for the works of the tent of testimony.
verses.4:44: And their registration according to their clans, according to their ancestral houses, was three thousand two hundred.
verses.4:45: This is the registration of the clan of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron registered by the voice of the Lord, by the hand of Moses.
verses.4:46: All those who were registered, whom Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel registered—the Levites—according to clans and according to ancestral houses,
verses.4:47: from twenty-five years old and upward to fifty years old, everyone who enters for the work of the works and the works that are carried in the tent of testimony;
verses.4:48: and those who were registered were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
verses.4:49: By the voice of the Lord he registered them by the hand of Moses, man by man, over their works and over what they themselves carry; and they were registered in the manner the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.5:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:2: "Command the sons of Israel, and let them send away from the camp every leper, and everyone who has a discharge, and everyone who is unclean because of a corpse;
verses.5:3: from male to female, send them away outside the camp, and they will by no means defile their camps, in which I dwell among them."
verses.5:4: And the sons of Israel did so, and they sent them away outside the camp; just as the Lord spoke to Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
verses.5:5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:6: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'A man or a woman—whoever commits any of the human sins and acts with utter disregard, and that person surely commits a trespass—
verses.5:7: he shall confess the sin that he committed, and shall repay the trespass, the principal, and shall add its fifth part to it, and shall repay the one against whom he trespassed.
verses.5:8: But if the person has no next of kin so as to repay the trespass to him, the trespass that is repaid to the Lord shall belong to the priest, apart from the ram of atonement through which he shall make atonement for him.
verses.5:9: And every firstfruit offering pertaining to all the things consecrated among the sons of Israel, whatever they present to the Lord, to the priest, shall belong to him.
verses.5:10: And to each one his consecrated things shall belong; a man who gives to the priest—it shall belong to him.'"
verses.5:11: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:12: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'If any man's wife transgresses and utterly disregards him,
verses.5:13: and someone lies with her in sexual intercourse, and it escapes the eyes of her husband and she keeps it secret, though she is defiled, and there was no witness with her and she has not been caught;
verses.5:14: and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife, and she is defiled, or a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife, and she is not defiled;
verses.5:15: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall present the gift for her, one-tenth of an ephah, barley flour; he shall not pour oil upon it, nor shall he put frankincense upon it, for it is a sacrifice of jealousy, a memorial sacrifice bringing sin to remembrance.
verses.5:16: And the priest shall bring her forward and set her before the Lord;
verses.5:17: and the priest shall take clean, living water in an earthenware vessel, and some of the earth that is on the floor of the tent of testimony, and the priest shall take it and put it into the water;
verses.5:18: and the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and uncover the head of the woman, and place upon her hands the memorial sacrifice, the sacrifice of jealousy; and in the hand of the priest shall be the water of this conviction that brings a curse.
verses.5:19: And the priest shall put her under oath and say to the woman, "If no one has lain with you, if you have not transgressed so as to be defiled while under your own husband, be unharmed by this water of conviction that brings a curse.
verses.5:20: But if you have transgressed, being under a husband, or have been defiled, and someone has had sexual intercourse with you besides your husband—"
verses.5:21: and the priest shall put the woman under oath with the words of this curse, and the priest shall say to the woman, "May the Lord make you a curse and an oath in the midst of your people, when the Lord makes your thigh fall away and your belly swell;
verses.5:22: and this water that brings a curse shall enter into your belly, to make the abdomen swell and your thigh fall away." And the woman shall say, "May it be so, may it be so."
verses.5:23: And the priest shall write these curses in a scroll, and wash them off into the water of conviction that brings a curse;
verses.5:24: and he shall make the woman drink the water of conviction that brings a curse, and the water of conviction that brings a curse shall enter into her.
verses.5:25: And the priest shall take from the hand of the woman the sacrifice of jealousy, and shall place the sacrifice before the Lord and present it to the altar;
verses.5:26: and the priest shall take a handful from the sacrifice, its memorial, and offer it up upon the altar, and after these things he shall make the woman drink the water.
verses.5:27: And it shall be, if she is defiled and completely escapes her husband's notice, then the water of conviction that brings a curse shall enter into her, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall fall away, and the woman shall become a curse to her people;
verses.5:28: but if the woman has not been defiled and is clean, then she shall be unharmed and shall bring forth seed.
verses.5:29: This is the law of jealousy, when a woman transgresses, being under a husband, and is defiled,
verses.5:30: or a man upon whom a spirit of jealousy comes and he is jealous of his wife; and he shall set his wife before the Lord, and the priest shall carry out for her all this law;
verses.5:31: and the man shall be innocent of sin, and that woman shall bear her sin.'"
verses.6:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Speak to the sons of Israel
verses.6:2: and you shall say to them, 'A man or a woman who solemnly vows a vow to keep himself pure in purity to the Lord
verses.6:3: from wine and strong drink, he shall keep himself pure from wine, and vinegar from wine and vinegar from strong drink he shall not drink, and whatever is made from grapes he shall not drink, and fresh grapes and raisins he shall not eat.
verses.6:4: All the days of his vow, from everything that is produced from the vine, wine from pressed grape skins to a grape seed he shall not eat.
verses.6:5: All the days of the purification, a razor shall not come upon his head; until the days which he vowed to the Lord are fulfilled, he shall be holy, letting the locks of hair of the head grow.
verses.6:6: All the days of the vow to the Lord, he shall not go in to any dead person. For a father and for a mother
verses.6:7: and for a brother and for a sister, he shall not be defiled for them when they die, because the vow of his God is upon him, upon his head;
verses.6:8: all the days of his vow he shall be holy to the Lord.
verses.6:9: But if someone dies suddenly beside him, immediately the head of his vow shall be defiled, and he shall shave his head on whatever day he is cleansed; on the seventh day he shall be shaved.
verses.6:10: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the doors of the tent of testimony,
verses.6:11: and the priest shall offer one for sin and one for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning what he sinned regarding the corpse, and he shall consecrate his head on that day on which he was consecrated to the Lord for the days of the vow,
verses.6:12: and he shall bring a year-old male lamb for a trespass offering; and the former days shall be uncounted, because the head of his vow was defiled.
verses.6:13: And this is the law of the one who has vowed: on whatever day he fulfills the days of his vow, he himself shall offer at the doors of the tent of testimony;
verses.6:14: and he shall bring his gift to the Lord: one year-old unblemished male lamb for a whole burnt offering, and one year-old unblemished female lamb for a sin offering, and one unblemished ram for a deliverance offering,
verses.6:15: and a basket of unleavened bread of fine flour, loaves kneaded with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their sacrifice and their drink offering.
verses.6:16: And the priest shall present them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering;
verses.6:17: and he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of deliverance to the Lord with the basket of unleavened bread, and the priest shall offer its sacrifice and its drink offering.
verses.6:18: And the one who has vowed shall shave the head of his vow at the doors of the tent of testimony, and he shall put the hair upon the fire that is under the sacrifice of deliverance.
verses.6:19: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder from the ram, and one unleavened loaf from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall place them upon the hands of the one who has vowed, after he has shaved his vow;
verses.6:20: and the priest shall present them as a placed offering before the Lord; it shall be holy for the priest, in addition to the breast of the placed offering and in addition to the shoulder of the set-apart offering; and after these things the one who has vowed may drink wine.
verses.6:21: This is the law of the one who has vowed, who vows to the Lord, his gift to the Lord concerning the vow, apart from whatever his hand may find, according to the extent of his vow which he vows, according to the law of purity.'"
verses.6:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:23: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'In this way you shall bless the sons of Israel, saying to them:
verses.6:24: "May the Lord bless you and guard you,
verses.6:25: and may the Lord make His face shine upon you and have mercy on you;
verses.6:26: may the Lord lift up His face upon you and give you peace."'
verses.7:1: Now it came about on the day when Moses finished setting up the tent that he anointed it and consecrated it, and all its utensils, and the altar and all its utensils, and he anointed them and consecrated them.
verses.7:2: And the leaders of Israel presented an offering, twelve leaders of their ancestral houses; these were the leaders of the tribes, these were the ones who stood over the inspection.
verses.7:3: And they brought their gift before the Lord: six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon from two leaders and a young bull from each one, and they brought them before the tent.
verses.7:4: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:5: "Accept them from them, and they shall be for the service tasks of the tent of testimony; and you shall give them to the Levites, to each according to his service."
verses.7:6: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
verses.7:7: Two of the wagons and four of the oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon according to their services,
verses.7:8: and four of the wagons and eight of the oxen he gave to the sons of Merari according to their services, through Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
verses.7:9: But to the sons of Kohath he did not give any, because they have the service duties of the sanctuary; they shall carry them on their shoulders.
verses.7:10: And the leaders presented offerings for the dedication of the altar on the day when he anointed it; and the leaders presented their gifts in front of the altar.
verses.7:11: And the Lord said to Moses, "One leader each day, a leader each day, they shall present their gifts for the dedication of the altar."
verses.7:12: And the one presenting his gift on the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab, leader of the tribe of Judah.
verses.7:13: And he presented his gift: one silver dish, its weight one hundred and thirty, one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel, both full of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice;
verses.7:14: one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
verses.7:15: one young bull from the cattle and one ram, a year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
verses.7:16: and one male goat from the goats for sin;

verses.7:89: When Moses went into the tent of testimony to speak with Him, he heard the voice of the Lord speaking to him from above the mercy seat, which is on the ark of the testimony, between the two cherubim; and He spoke to him.
verses.8:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Speak to Aaron
verses.8:2: and you shall say to him, 'When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light on the side in front of the lampstand.'"
verses.8:3: And Aaron did so; on the one side in front of the lampstand he lit its lamps.
verses.8:4: And this was the construction of the lampstand: solid gold, its shaft and its lilies, entirely solid; according to the form that the Lord showed to Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.8:5: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:6: "Take the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel and you shall purify them.
verses.8:7: And in this way you shall perform their purification for them: you shall sprinkle them with water of purification, and a razor shall pass over their whole body, and they shall wash their garments, and they shall be clean.
verses.8:8: And they shall take one calf from the cattle and its sacrifice of fine flour mixed with oil, and you shall take a year-old calf from the cattle for sin.
verses.8:9: And you shall bring the Levites forward before the tent of testimony, and you shall assemble the whole assembly of the sons of Israel;
verses.8:10: and you shall bring the Levites forward before the Lord, and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites;
verses.8:11: and Aaron shall set apart the Levites as a gift before the Lord from the sons of Israel, and they shall be for performing the works of the Lord.
verses.8:12: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the calves, and he shall offer the one for sin and the one for a whole burnt offering to the Lord, to make atonement for them.
verses.8:13: And you shall stand the Levites before the Lord, before Aaron and before his sons, and you shall give them over as a gift before the Lord;
verses.8:14: and you shall separate the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and they shall be Mine.
verses.8:15: And after these things the Levites shall enter to perform the works of the tent of testimony, and you shall cleanse them, and you shall give them over before the Lord.
verses.8:16: For these have been given over to Me as a gift from the midst of the sons of Israel; in place of those who open every womb, all the firstborn of those from the sons of Israel, I have taken them for Myself.
verses.8:17: For Mine is every firstborn among the sons of Israel, from humans to livestock; on the day I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated them for Myself.
verses.8:18: And I took the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
verses.8:19: And I gave over the Levites as a gift given to Aaron and to his sons from the midst of the sons of Israel, to perform the works of the sons of Israel in the tent of testimony and to make atonement for the sons of Israel; and there shall not be among the sons of Israel anyone approaching the holy things."
verses.8:20: And Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly of the sons of Israel did to the Levites just as the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites; so the sons of Israel did to them.
verses.8:21: And the Levites purified themselves and washed their garments; and Aaron gave them over as a gift before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement for them to purify them.
verses.8:22: And after these things the Levites entered to perform their service in the tent of testimony before Aaron and before his sons; just as the Lord directed Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
verses.8:23: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:24: "This is what concerns the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall enter to work in the tent of testimony;
verses.8:25: and from fifty years old he shall withdraw from the service, and he does not work anymore,
verses.8:26: and his brother shall serve in the tent of testimony to keep watches, but he does not perform works. In this way you shall do to the Levites in their watches."
verses.9:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,
verses.9:2: "Speak, and let the sons of Israel observe the Passover at its time;
verses.9:3: on the fourteenth day of the first month toward evening you shall observe it at the appointed times; according to its law and according to its ruling you shall observe it."
verses.9:4: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel to observe the Passover, beginning on the fourteenth day of the month in the wilderness of Sinai;
verses.9:5: just as the Lord directed Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
verses.9:6: And the men arrived who were unclean because of a human corpse and could not observe the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day;
verses.9:7: and those men said to him, "We are unclean because of a human corpse; should we then fail to present the offering to the Lord at its appointed time in the midst of the sons of Israel?"
verses.9:8: And Moses said to them, "Stand here, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you."
verses.9:9: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.9:10: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'Any person who becomes unclean because of a human corpse, or is on a journey far away, among you or in your generations, he shall observe the Passover to the Lord; in the second month, on the fourteenth day,
verses.9:11: toward evening, they shall observe it. With unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it;
verses.9:12: they shall not leave any of it until the morning, and they shall not break a bone from it; according to the law of the Passover they shall observe it.
verses.9:13: And a person who is clean and is not on a distant journey and fails to observe the Passover, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from its people; because he did not present the offering to the Lord at its appointed time, that person shall bear his sin.
verses.9:14: And if a resident alien comes to you in your land and observes the Passover to the Lord, according to the law of the Passover and according to its regulation he shall observe it; there shall be one law for you, both for the resident alien and for the native of the land.'"
verses.9:15: And on the day that the tent was set up, the cloud covered the tent, the house of the testimony; and in the evening it was over the tent like an appearance of fire until morning.
verses.9:16: So it happened continually: the cloud covered it by day and an appearance of fire by night.
verses.9:17: And whenever the cloud went up from the tent, after that the sons of Israel set out. And in the place where the cloud stood, there the sons of Israel encamped.
verses.9:18: By the command of the Lord the sons of Israel will encamp; by the command of the Lord they will set out. All the days in which the cloud overshadows the tent, the sons of Israel will encamp.
verses.9:19: And when the cloud lingers over the tent for many days, the sons of Israel will keep the watch of God and will by no means depart;
verses.9:20: and it will be, when the cloud covers the tent for a number of days, by the voice of the Lord they will encamp, and by the command of the Lord they will set out.
verses.9:21: And it will be, when the cloud is present from evening until morning, and the cloud goes up in the morning, they will set out, by day or by night.
verses.9:22: For a month, for days, while the cloud stays longer, overshadowing it, the sons of Israel will encamp and will by no means set out.
verses.9:23: For by the command of the Lord they will set out, the watch of the Lord which they kept by the command of the Lord through the hand of Moses.
verses.10:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Make for yourself two trumpets;
verses.10:2: of hammered silver you shall make them for yourself. And they will be for you to summon the congregation and to move out the camps.
verses.10:3: And you shall blow on them, and all the congregation will be gathered to the doorway of the tent of testimony;
verses.10:4: but if they blow on one, all the rulers, the leaders of Israel, will come to you.
verses.10:5: And you shall blow a signal, and the camps encamping on the east will set out;
verses.10:6: and you shall blow a second signal, and the camps encamping on the south will set out; and you shall blow a third signal, and the camps encamping by the sea will set out; and you shall blow a fourth signal, and the camps encamping toward the north will set out; they shall blow with a signal at their setting out.
verses.10:7: And whenever you gather the congregation, you shall blow, and not with a signal.
verses.10:8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets, and it will be for you an eternal statute for your generations.
verses.10:9: And if you go out to war in your land against the adversaries who oppose you, then you shall sound a signal with the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the Lord, and you will be saved from your enemies.
verses.10:10: And in the days of your gladness, and at your feasts, and at your new moons, you shall blow the trumpets over the whole burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your deliverance, and it will be a remembrance for you before your God; I am the Lord your God."
verses.10:11: And it happened in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth of the month, that the cloud went up from the tent of testimony,
verses.10:12: and the sons of Israel set out with their baggage in the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stood still in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.10:13: And they set out first at the voice of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.10:14: And the division of the camp of the sons of Judah set out first with their force, and over their force was Nahshon son of Amminadab;
verses.10:15: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Issachar was Nethanel son of Zuar;
verses.10:16: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun was Eliab son of Helon.
verses.10:17: And they will take down the tent, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari will set out, carrying the tent.
verses.10:18: And the division of the camp of Reuben set out with their force, and over their force was Elizur son of Shedeur;
verses.10:19: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Simeon was Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
verses.10:20: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.10:21: And the sons of Kohath will set out, carrying the holy things, and they will set up the tent by the time they arrive.
verses.10:22: And the division of the camp of Ephraim will set out with their force; over their force is Elishama son of Ammihud;
verses.10:23: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh is Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur;
verses.10:24: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin is Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.10:25: And the division of the camp of the sons of Dan will set out last of all the camps with their force, and over their force is Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai;
verses.10:26: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Asher is Pagiel son of Ochran;
verses.10:27: and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan.
verses.10:28: These are the armies of the sons of Israel, and they set out with their force.
verses.10:29: And Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, "We are setting out to the place of which the Lord said, 'This I will give to you'; come with us, and we will do good to you, for the Lord has spoken good things concerning Israel."
verses.10:30: And he said to him, "I will not go, but rather to my land and to my family."
verses.10:31: And he said, "Do not leave us, because you were with us in the wilderness, and you will be an elder among us;
verses.10:32: and it will be, if you go with us, that whatever those good things are with which the Lord does good to us, we will do good to you as well."
verses.10:33: And they set out from the mountain of the Lord a three days' journey; and the ark of the covenant of the Lord was going ahead before them a three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.10:34: And it happened, when the ark set out, that Moses said, "Rise up, Lord, let Your enemies be scattered, let all who hate You flee."
verses.10:35: And at the resting he said, "Return, Lord, thousands, ten thousands in Israel."
verses.10:36: And the cloud was overshadowing them by day and when they set out from the camp.
verses.11:1: And the people were grumbling evil things before the Lord; and the Lord heard and became furious with anger, and fire from the Lord blazed up among them and consumed a part of the camp.
verses.11:2: And the people cried out to Moses; and Moses prayed to the Lord, and the fire died down.
verses.11:3: And the name of that place was called Burning, because fire from the Lord blazed up among them.
verses.11:4: And the mixed crowd that was among them craved a craving; and sitting down, the sons of Israel also wept and said, "Who will feed us meat?
verses.11:5: We remember the fish that we used to eat in Egypt for free, and the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;
verses.11:6: but now our soul is dried up; there is nothing, except our eyes are on the manna."
verses.11:7: Now the manna is like coriander seed, and its appearance is the appearance of crystal.
verses.11:8: And the people went about and gathered it, and ground it in the mill and pounded it in the mortar, and boiled it in the pot and made it into hearth cakes; and its flavor was like the taste of a pastry made with oil.
verses.11:9: And whenever the dew came down upon the camp at night, the manna came down upon it.
verses.11:10: And Moses heard them weeping according to their clans, each at his doorway; and the Lord became exceedingly furious with anger, and before Moses it was evil.
verses.11:11: And Moses said to the Lord, "Why have You afflicted Your servant? And why have I not found favor before You, that You lay the impulse of this people upon me?
verses.11:12: Did I conceive all this people, or did I give birth to them, that You say to me, 'Take him into your bosom, as a nurse would carry the nursing child,' to the land that You swore to their fathers?
verses.11:13: Where am I to get meat to give to all this people? For they weep at me, saying, 'Give us meat so that we may eat.'
verses.11:14: I alone will not be able to bear this people, because this matter is too heavy for me.
verses.11:15: And if You deal with me this way, kill me outright, if I have found mercy with You, so that I may not see my affliction."
verses.11:16: And the Lord said to Moses, "Gather for Me seventy men from the elders of Israel, of whom you yourself have seen that they are elders of the people and their scribes. And you shall bring them to the tent of testimony, and they will stand there with you.
verses.11:17: And I will come down and speak there with you, and I will take some of the Spirit on you and place some on them; and they will help bear the impulse of the people with you, and you will not bear them alone.
verses.11:18: And to the people you shall say, 'Purify yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; because you wept before the Lord, saying, "Who will feed us meat? For it is good for us in Egypt." And the Lord will give you meat to eat, and you will eat meat.
verses.11:19: You will not eat one day, nor two, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.11:20: up to a month of days you will eat, until meat comes out of your nostrils, and it will become cholera to you; because you disobeyed the Lord who is among you, and wept before Him, saying, "Why did we come out of Egypt?"'"
verses.11:21: And Moses said to the Lord, "Six hundred thousand on foot are the people among whom I am, and You have said, 'I will give them meat to eat, and they will eat for a month of days.'
verses.11:22: Will sheep and cattle be slaughtered for them, and will it be enough for them? Or will all the fish of the sea be gathered for them, and will it be enough for them?"
verses.11:23: And the Lord said to Moses, "Will the hand of the Lord not be sufficient? Now you will know whether My word will overtake you or not."
verses.11:24: And Moses went out and spoke to the people the words of the Lord, and he gathered seventy men from the elders of the people and stationed them around the tent.
verses.11:25: And the Lord came down in a cloud and spoke to him, and took some of the Spirit on him and placed some upon the seventy men, the elders; and when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and they did not do so again.
verses.11:26: And two men were left behind in the camp; the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the second was Medad, and the Spirit rested upon them; and these were among those who had been registered, and they did not come to the tent; and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.11:27: And the young man ran up and reported to Moses and spoke, saying, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.11:28: And Joshua the son of Nun, who stood beside Moses, the chosen one, answered and said, "Master Moses, stop them."
verses.11:29: And Moses said to him, "Are you jealous for me? And who would grant all the people of the Lord to be prophets, whenever the Lord puts His Spirit upon them?"
verses.11:30: And Moses went away into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.11:31: And a wind went out from the Lord and brought across quail from the sea, and cast them upon the camp a day's journey on this side and a day's journey on that side, around the camp, about two cubits above the ground.
verses.11:32: And the people rose up all the day and all the night and all the next day, and gathered the quail; the one who gathered the least gathered ten kors; and they slaughtered drying heaps for themselves around the camp.
verses.11:33: The meat was still in their teeth before it ran out, and the Lord became furious against His people; and the Lord struck the people with an exceedingly great plague.
verses.11:34: And the name of that place was called Graves of Craving; there they buried the craving people.
verses.11:35: From Graves of Craving the people set out to Hazeroth, and the people were in Hazeroth.
verses.12:1: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses on account of the Ethiopian woman whom Moses had taken, because he had taken an Ethiopian woman.
verses.12:2: And they said, "Has the Lord spoken to Moses alone? Did He not also speak to us?" And the Lord heard.
verses.12:3: Now the man Moses was very gentle, more than all the people who were on the earth.
verses.12:4: And the Lord said to Moses, Miriam, and Aaron, "Come out, you three, to the tent of testimony." And the three went out to the tent of testimony.
verses.12:5: And the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the door of the tent of testimony; and Aaron and Miriam were called, and both of them came out.
verses.12:6: And He said to them, "Hear My words: If there is a prophet of yours for the Lord, in a vision I will make Myself known to him, and in sleep I will speak to him.
verses.12:7: Not so is My attendant Moses; in all My house he is faithful.
verses.12:8: Mouth to mouth I will speak to him, in visible form and not through riddles, and he has seen the glory of the Lord. And why were you not afraid to speak against My attendant Moses?"
verses.12:9: And the wrath of the Lord's fury was upon them, and He departed.
verses.12:10: And the cloud withdrew from the tent, and look, Miriam was leprous, like snow. And Aaron looked at Miriam, and look, she was leprous.
verses.12:11: And Aaron said to Moses, "I beg you, lord, do not lay sin upon us, for we acted in ignorance, in that we have sinned.
verses.12:12: Let her not become like something equal to death, like a stillborn child coming out from a mother's womb; it devours half of her flesh."
verses.12:13: And Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, "God, I beg You, heal her."
verses.12:14: And the Lord said to Moses, "If her father had indeed spit in her face, would she not be ashamed for seven days? Let her be separated for seven days outside the camp, and after this she will come in."
verses.12:15: And Miriam was separated outside the camp for seven days; and the people did not set out until Miriam was cleansed.
verses.12:16: And after this the people set out from Hazeroth and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.13:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.13:2: "Send men for yourself, and let them scout out the land of the Canaanites, which I am giving to the sons of Israel for a possession; sending them one man for each tribe according to the clans of their fathers' houses, every one a leader from among them."
verses.13:3: And Moses sent them out from the wilderness of Paran by the voice of the Lord; all of these men were leaders of the sons of Israel.
verses.13:4: And these are their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Samuel son of Zaccur;
verses.13:5: of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Suri;
verses.13:6: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
verses.13:7: of the tribe of Issachar, Ilaal son of Joseph;
verses.13:8: of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
verses.13:9: of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
verses.13:10: of the tribe of Zebulun, Gudiel son of Sodi;
verses.13:11: of the tribe of Joseph, of the sons of Manasseh, Gaddi son of Susi;
verses.13:12: of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gamai;
verses.13:13: of the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
verses.13:14: of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Jabi;
verses.13:15: of the tribe of Gad, Gudiel son of Maki.
verses.13:16: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to scout out the land. And Moses named Hoshea son of Nun Joshua.
verses.13:17: And Moses sent them to scout out the land of Canaan and said to them, "Go up through this wilderness, and you will go up into the mountain;
verses.13:18: and you will see the land, what it is like, and the people who are settled on it, whether they are stronger or weak, whether they are few or many;
verses.13:19: and what the land is like on which they are settled, whether it is good or bad; and what the cities are like in which they dwell, whether in walled ones or in unwalled ones;
verses.13:20: and what the land is like, whether rich or depleted, whether there are trees in it or not. And persevere and take from the fruits of the land." Now the days were days of spring, forerunners of the grape.
verses.13:21: And they went up and scouted out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rahab, as one enters Hephaath.
verses.13:22: And they went up through the wilderness and came as far as Hebron, and there were Ahiman, Sheshai, and Thelamin, offspring of Anak. Now Hebron was built seven years before Tanis of Egypt.
verses.13:23: And they came as far as the Valley of the Cluster and scouted it out; and they cut from there vine branches and one cluster of grapes on it, and they carried it on poles, and some of the pomegranates and some of the cucumbers.
verses.13:24: They named that place Valley of the Cluster, because of the cluster that the sons of Israel cut from there.
verses.13:25: And they returned from there, having scouted out the land, after forty days.
verses.13:26: And they went and came to Moses and Aaron and to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, into the wilderness of Paran, Kadesh; and they answered them and the whole congregation with a word, and showed the fruit of the land.
verses.13:27: And they related to him and said, "We came into the land to which you sent us, a land flowing with milk and honey, and this is its fruit;
verses.13:28: except that the nation that dwells on it is bold, and the cities are fortified, walled, and very large, and we have seen the offspring of Anak there;
verses.13:29: and Amalek dwells in the land toward the south, and the Hittite, the Hivite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country, and the Canaanite dwells beside the sea."
verses.13:30: And Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said to him, "No, rather we will surely go up and inherit it, for we will certainly prevail against them."
verses.13:31: And the men who had gone up with him said, "We are not going up, because we will by no means be able to go up against the nation, for it is much stronger than we are."
verses.13:32: And they brought out to the sons of Israel dismay concerning the land that they had scouted out, saying, "The land through which we passed to scout it out is a land that devours those who dwell on it; all the people whom we have seen in it are exceedingly tall men there;
verses.13:33: and there we have seen the giants, and we were before them like locusts; and indeed, even so we were before them."
verses.14:1: Then the whole congregation raised and let out a cry, and the people wept all that night.
verses.14:2: And all the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them,
verses.14:3: "If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if only we had died in this wilderness! And why is the Lord bringing us into this land to fall in war? Our wives and little ones will become plunder. So now it is better for us to turn back to Egypt."
verses.14:4: And they said to one another, "Let us appoint a leader and turn back to Egypt."
verses.14:5: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown before the whole congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.14:6: And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, from among those who had spied out the land, tore their garments.
verses.14:7: And they spoke to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "The land that we spied out is exceedingly, exceedingly good.
verses.14:8: If the Lord favors us, He will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land that is flowing with milk and honey.
verses.14:9: Only do not become rebels against the Lord; and you, do not fear the people of the land, for they are food for us. For the opportunity has departed from them, but the Lord is among us; do not fear them."
verses.14:10: And the whole congregation said to stone them. And the glory of the Lord appeared in a cloud over the tent of testimony to all the sons of Israel.
verses.14:11: Then the Lord said to Moses, "How long will this people provoke Me? And how long will they not believe Me in spite of all the signs that I have performed among them?
verses.14:12: I will strike them with death and destroy them, and I will make you and the house of your father into a nation great and more numerous than this one."
verses.14:13: And Moses said to the Lord, "Then Egypt will hear, for You brought this people out from among them by Your strength;
verses.14:14: moreover, all those who dwell on this land have also heard that You are the Lord among this people—You who are seen eye to eye, Lord. And Your cloud stands over them, and in a pillar of cloud You go along ahead of them by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.14:15: And You will wipe out this people like one man, and the nations, all who have heard Your name, will speak, saying,
verses.14:16: 'Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land that He swore to them, He laid them low in the wilderness.'
verses.14:17: And now, let Your strength be exalted, Lord, just as You spoke, saying,
verses.14:18: 'The Lord is slow to anger and abundant in mercy and true, taking away lawless deeds and injustices and sins; yet He will by no means clear the guilty, repaying sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth generation.'
verses.14:19: Forgive the sin of this people according to Your great mercy, just as You have been gracious to them from Egypt until now."
verses.14:20: And the Lord said to Moses, "I am gracious to them according to your word.
verses.14:21: Yet as I live and as My name lives, the glory of the Lord will fill all the earth.
verses.14:22: For all the men who have seen My glory and the signs that I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tested Me this tenth time and have not listened to My voice,
verses.14:23: they will certainly not see the land that I swore to their fathers. Rather, their children who are with Me here, all who do not know good or evil, every inexperienced youth—to these I will give the land; but all who provoked Me will not see it.
verses.14:24: But as for My servant Caleb, because there was a different spirit in him and he followed closely after Me, I will bring him into the land that he entered, and his seed will inherit it.
verses.14:25: Now Amalek and the Canaanite dwell in the valley. Tomorrow turn back and set out into the wilderness by the way of the Red Sea."
verses.14:26: Then the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.14:27: "How long must I bear with this evil congregation? They are grumbling before Me. I have heard the grumbling of the sons of Israel, which they grumbled about you.
verses.14:28: Say to them, 'As I live, says the Lord, surely just as you have spoken in My ears, so I will do to you:
verses.14:29: In this wilderness your corpses will fall, and all your census and those of you who were numbered, from twenty years old and upward, all who grumbled against Me.
verses.14:30: You will certainly not enter the land concerning which I stretched out My hand to settle you upon it, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.14:31: But as for the little ones, who you said would be plunder, I will bring them into the land, and they will inherit the land from which you turned away.
verses.14:32: And your corpses will fall in this wilderness.
verses.14:33: And your sons will be pasturing in the wilderness for forty years, and they will bear your prostitution until your corpses are consumed in the wilderness.
verses.14:34: According to the number of the days that you spied out the land, forty days—a day for a year—you will bear your sins for forty years, and you will know the fury of My wrath.
verses.14:35: I, the Lord, have spoken: surely I will do so to this evil congregation that has banded together against Me; in this wilderness they will be completely consumed, and there they will die.'"
verses.14:36: And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who upon returning grumbled against it to the congregation, putting forth evil words about the land—
verses.14:37: the men who spoke evil things against the land died in the plague before the Lord.
verses.14:38: But Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive from among those men who had gone to spy out the land.
verses.14:39: Then Moses spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
verses.14:40: And rising early in the morning, they went up to the top of the mountain, saying, "Look, here we are; we will go up to the place of which the Lord spoke, for we have sinned."
verses.14:41: And Moses said, "Why are you transgressing the word of the Lord? It will not go well for you.
verses.14:42: Do not go up, for the Lord is not with you, and you will fall before your enemies.
verses.14:43: For Amalek and the Canaanite are there in front of you, and you will fall by the sword; because you have turned away, disobeying the Lord, the Lord will not be among you."
verses.14:44: Yet forcing their way forward, they went up to the top of the mountain; but the ark of the covenant of the Lord and Moses did not move from the camp.
verses.14:45: Then Amalek and the Canaanite who was settled in that mountain came down, and they routed them and cut them down as far as Hormah; and they turned back to the camp.
verses.15:1: And the Lord said to Moses, saying, "Speak to the sons of Israel
verses.15:2: and you shall say to them, 'When you enter the land of your dwelling, which I am giving to you,
verses.15:3: and you make burnt offerings to the Lord, a whole offering or a sacrifice, to magnify a vow or voluntarily, or at your feasts to make an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord, whether from the cattle or from the sheep,
verses.15:4: then the one presenting his gift to the Lord shall present a sacrifice of fine flour, a tenth of an ephah, mixed with oil, a fourth of a hin;
verses.15:5: and you shall prepare wine for a drink offering, a fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or with the sacrifice; for each lamb you shall prepare this much, an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.15:6: And for a ram, when you prepare it either for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, you shall prepare a sacrifice of fine flour, two tenths, mixed with oil, a third of a hin;
verses.15:7: and you shall present wine for a drink offering, a third of a hin, for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.15:8: Now if you prepare from the cattle for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to magnify a vow for a deliverance offering to the Lord,
verses.15:9: then he shall present with the calf a sacrifice of fine flour, three tenths, mixed with oil, half of a hin,
verses.15:10: an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.15:11: In this way you shall do for each calf, or for each ram, or for each lamb from the sheep or from the goats.
verses.15:12: According to the number of those that you prepare, so you shall do for each one according to their number.
verses.15:13: Every native-born person shall do such things in this way, to present offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.15:14: And if a resident alien comes among you in your land, or whoever comes to be among you in your generations, and makes an offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord, in the way that you do, so the congregation shall do to the Lord.
verses.15:15: There shall be one law for you and for the resident aliens dwelling among you, an eternal law throughout your generations; as you are, the resident alien shall also be before the Lord.
verses.15:16: There shall be one law and there shall be one ordinance also for the resident alien dwelling among you.'"
verses.15:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.15:18: "Speak to the sons of Israel and you shall say to them, 'When you enter the land into which I am bringing you,
verses.15:19: then it shall be that when you eat from the bread of the land, you shall set aside a contribution, a set-apart portion to the Lord.
verses.15:20: As the firstfruits of your dough, you shall set apart a loaf as a contribution; like a contribution from a threshing floor, so you shall set it aside,
verses.15:21: the firstfruits of your dough; and you shall give to the Lord a contribution throughout your generations.
verses.15:22: Now when you err and do not do all these commandments that the Lord spoke to Moses,
verses.15:23: just as the Lord commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day on which the Lord commanded you and onward throughout your generations,
verses.15:24: then it shall be, if it is done unintentionally away from the eyes of the congregation, that the entire congregation shall prepare one unblemished calf from the cattle for a burnt offering, for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord, and its sacrifice and its drink offering according to the regulation, and one male goat from the goats for sin.
verses.15:25: And the priest shall make atonement for it, for the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, because it is unintentional; and they themselves brought their gift, an offering to the Lord for their sin before the Lord, for their unintentional acts.
verses.15:26: And it shall be forgiven throughout the entire congregation of the sons of Israel and to the resident alien dwelling with you, because for all the people it is unintentional.
verses.15:27: And if one person sins unintentionally, he shall bring one year-old female goat for sin;
verses.15:28: and the priest shall make atonement for the person who acted unintentionally and sinned unintentionally before the Lord, to make atonement for him.
verses.15:29: For the native among the sons of Israel and for the resident alien dwelling among them, there shall be one law for them, whoever acts unintentionally.
verses.15:30: And a person who acts with a hand of arrogance, from the native-born or from the resident aliens, this one provokes God; that person shall be destroyed from among his people.
verses.15:31: Because he scorned the words of the Lord and broke His commandments, that person shall be completely wiped out; his sin is in him.'"
verses.15:32: And the sons of Israel were in the wilderness, and they found a man gathering wood on the Sabbath day.
verses.15:33: And those who found him gathering wood on the Sabbath day brought him to Moses and Aaron and to the entire congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.15:34: And they placed him in custody, for they had not decided what they should do to him.
verses.15:35: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "The man shall surely be put to death; stone him with stones, all the congregation."
verses.15:36: And the entire congregation brought him outside the camp, and the entire congregation stoned him with stones outside the camp, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.15:37: And the Lord said to Moses, saying,
verses.15:38: "Speak to the sons of Israel and you shall say to them, and let them make for themselves tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and you shall put a blue cord on the tassels of the corners.
verses.15:39: And it shall be for you in the tassels, and you shall look at them, and you shall remember all the commandments of the Lord and do them, and you shall not turn aside after your thoughts and eyes, after which you prostitute yourselves, so that you may remember and do all My commandments,
verses.15:40: and you shall be holy to your God.
verses.15:41: I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God; I am the Lord your God."
verses.16:1: And Korah, son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On, son of Peleth, son of Reuben, spoke;
verses.16:2: and they rose up before Moses, along with two hundred and fifty men of the sons of Israel, leaders of the congregation, summoned to the council, and renowned men;
verses.16:3: They banded together behind Moses and Aaron and said, "Let it be enough for you, because all the congregation, all of them, are holy, and the Lord is among them; and why do you rise up against the congregation of the Lord?"
verses.16:4: And when Moses heard, he fell on his face,
verses.16:5: and he spoke to Korah and to all his congregation, saying, "God has examined and known those who are His and the holy ones, and He brought them near to Himself, and those whom He chose for Himself, He brought near to Himself.
verses.16:6: Do this: take censers for yourselves, Korah and all his congregation,
verses.16:7: and put fire on them, and put incense on them before the Lord tomorrow; and it will be that the man whom the Lord chooses, this one is holy; let it be enough for you, sons of Levi."
verses.16:8: And Moses said to Korah, "Listen to me, sons of Levi.
verses.16:9: Is this a small thing to you, that the God of Israel separated you from the congregation of Israel and brought you near to Himself to perform the services of the tent of the Lord, and to stand before the tent to serve them,
verses.16:10: and brought you near, and all your brothers, the sons of Levi, with you? And do you also seek to serve as priests?
verses.16:11: Thus you and all your congregation are gathered together against God; and who is Aaron, that you grumble against him?"
verses.16:12: And Moses sent to summon Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab. And they said, "We are not going up;
verses.16:13: is this a small thing, that you brought us up into a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you rule over us as a ruler?
verses.16:14: Even if you had brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, and had given us an inheritance of a field and vineyards, you would have gouged out the eyes of those men; we are not going up."
verses.16:15: And Moses was exceedingly indignant, and said to the Lord, "Do not have regard for their sacrifice; I have not taken any desirable thing from any of them, nor have I harmed any one of them."
verses.16:16: And Moses said to Korah, "Sanctify your congregation, and be ready before the Lord, you and they and Aaron, tomorrow;
verses.16:17: and each of you take his censer, and you will put incense on them, and each of you will bring his censer before the Lord, two hundred and fifty censers, and you and Aaron, each his censer."
verses.16:18: And each one took his censer, and they put fire on them, and laid incense on it; and Moses and Aaron stood by the doors of the tent of testimony.
verses.16:19: And Korah assembled all his congregation against them by the door of the tent of testimony; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the congregation.
