verses.16:20: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.16:21: "Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation, and I will consume them all at once."
verses.16:22: And they fell on their faces and said, "God, God of the spirits and of all flesh, if one man has sinned, is the wrath of the Lord upon all the congregation?"
verses.16:23: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.16:24: "Speak to the congregation, saying, 'Withdraw from around the congregation of Korah.'"
verses.16:25: And Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and all the elders of Israel went along with him.
verses.16:26: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Separate yourselves from the tents of these harsh men, and do not touch anything of all that belongs to them, so that you do not perish together with all your belongings."
verses.16:27: And they withdrew from around the tent of Korah; and Dathan and Abiram came out and were standing by the doors of their tents, and their wives and their children and their dependents.
verses.16:28: And Moses said, "By this you will know that the Lord sent me to do all these works, that it is not from myself;
verses.16:29: if these men die according to the death of all people, and if according to the visitation of all people there is a visitation for them, the Lord has not sent me.
verses.16:30: But the Lord will show it by a portent, and the earth will open its mouth and swallow them up, and their houses and their tents and all that belongs to them, and they will go down alive into Hades, and you will know that these men have provoked the Lord."
verses.16:31: And when he finished speaking all these words, the earth split open beneath them,
verses.16:32: and the earth opened and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the people who were with Korah, and their livestock.
verses.16:33: And they and all that belonged to them went down alive into Hades, and the earth covered them, and they perished from the midst of the congregation.
verses.16:34: And all Israel who were around them fled from their cry, for they were saying, "The earth might swallow us up."
verses.16:35: And fire went out from the Lord and devoured the two hundred and fifty men who were offering the incense.
verses.17:1: And the Lord said to Moses
verses.17:2: and to Eleazar the son of Aaron, the priest, "Take up the bronze censers from the midst of those who were burned up, and scatter this strange fire there, because they sanctified the censers of these sinners with their lives;
verses.17:3: and make them into hammered plates, a covering for the altar, because they were offered before the Lord and were sanctified, and they became a sign to the sons of Israel."
verses.17:4: And Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, took the bronze censers that those who were burned up had offered, and they placed them as a covering for the altar,
verses.17:5: a memorial to the sons of Israel, so that no outsider who is not from the seed of Aaron may approach to put incense before the Lord, and he will not become like Korah and his faction; just as the Lord spoke to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.17:6: And the sons of Israel grumbled the next day against Moses and Aaron, saying, "You have killed the people of the Lord."
verses.17:7: And it happened, while the congregation was banding together against Moses and Aaron, that they rushed toward the tent of testimony; and this one, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.17:8: And Moses and Aaron went in before the tent of testimony;
verses.17:9: and the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.17:10: "Depart from the midst of this congregation, and I will consume them all at once." And they fell on their faces.
verses.17:11: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take the censer, and put fire on it from the altar, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly into the camp, and it will make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the presence of the Lord; it has begun to shatter the people."
verses.17:12: And Aaron took it just as Moses had spoken to him, and ran into the congregation; and the plague had already begun among the people. And he laid on the incense and made atonement for the people;
verses.17:13: and he stood between the dead and the living, and the plague ceased among the people.
verses.17:14: And those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died on account of Korah.
verses.17:15: And Aaron returned to Moses at the door of the tent of testimony, and the plague ceased.
verses.17:16: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:17: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and take from them a staff, a staff according to ancestral houses, from all their rulers, according to their ancestral houses, twelve staffs; and write each one's name on the staff.
verses.17:18: And write the name of Aaron on the staff of Levi; for there is one staff; they will give it according to the tribe of their ancestral house.
verses.17:19: And you will place them in the tent of testimony, in front of the testimony, where I will be made known to you there.
verses.17:20: And it will be that the man whom I choose, his staff will sprout; and I will remove from Myself the grumbling of the sons of Israel, which they grumble against you."
verses.17:21: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel; and all their rulers gave him a staff, for the one ruler a staff, ruler by ruler, according to their ancestral houses, twelve staffs; and the staff of Aaron was among their staffs.
verses.17:22: And Moses deposited the staffs before the Lord in the tent of testimony.
verses.17:23: And it happened on the next day that Moses and Aaron entered the tent of testimony, and look, the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted, and brought forth a sprout, and bloomed with blossoms, and produced nuts.
verses.17:24: And Moses brought out all the staffs from the presence of the Lord to all the sons of Israel; and they saw, and each one took his staff.
verses.17:25: And the Lord said to Moses, "Deposit the staff of Aaron before the testimonies for safekeeping, a sign to the sons of the disobedient; and let their grumbling cease from Me, and they will certainly not die."
verses.17:26: And Moses and Aaron did just as the Lord commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.17:27: And the sons of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, "Look, we have been consumed, we have perished, we are utterly consumed;
verses.17:28: everyone who touches the tent of the Lord dies; must we die to the very end?"
verses.18:1: And the Lord said to Aaron, saying, "You and your sons and the house of your ancestral family shall receive the firstfruits of the holy things; you and your sons shall bear the sins of your priesthood.
verses.18:2: And bring near to yourself your brothers, the tribe of Levi, the clan of your father, and let them be joined to you and serve you; and you and your sons with you shall be before the tent of testimony.
verses.18:3: And they shall keep your duties and the duties of the tent; however, they shall not come near to the holy vessels and to the altar, and neither they nor you shall die.
verses.18:4: And they shall be joined to you, and they shall keep the duties of the tent of testimony for all the services of the tent, and an outsider shall not come near to you.
verses.18:5: And you shall keep the duties of the holy things and the duties of the altar, and there shall be no wrath among the sons of Israel.
verses.18:6: And I have taken your brothers the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, a gift given to the Lord, to perform the services of the tent of testimony;
verses.18:7: and you and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for every matter of the altar and what is inside the curtain, and you shall perform the services as a gift of your priesthood; and the outsider who comes near shall die."
verses.18:8: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, "And look, I have given to you the keeping of the firstfruits from all the things consecrated to Me by the sons of Israel; to you I have given them as a gift of honor, and to your sons after you, as an eternal statute.
verses.18:9: And let this be yours from the consecrated holy things of the fire offerings, from all their gifts and from all the sacrifices and from every guilt offering of theirs and from all the sin offerings: whatever they render to Me from all the holy things shall belong to you and to your sons.
verses.18:10: In the holy of holies you shall eat them; every male shall eat them, you and your sons; they shall be holy to you.
verses.18:11: And this shall be yours from the firstfruits of their gifts, from all the laid-on offerings of the sons of Israel; to you I have given them, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as an eternal statute; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat them.
verses.18:12: Every firstfruit of oil and every firstfruit of wine, their firstfruit of grain—whatever they give to the Lord, to you I have given them.
verses.18:13: All the first produce, whatever is in their land, whatever they bring to the Lord, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat them.
verses.18:14: Everything devoted among the sons of Israel shall be yours.
verses.18:15: And everything that opens a womb from all flesh, which they offer to the Lord, from human to animal, shall be yours; however, the firstborn of humans shall be redeemed with a ransom, and the firstborn of the unclean animals you shall redeem.
verses.18:16: And its redemption shall be from one month old; the valuation is five shekels according to the holy shekel, which is twenty obols.
verses.18:17: However, the firstborn of calves and the firstborn of sheep and the firstborn of goats you shall not redeem; they are holy. And you shall pour out their blood against the altar, and the fat you shall offer up as a fire offering, for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord;
verses.18:18: and the flesh shall be yours; and the breast of the laid-on offering, and as with the right shoulder, it shall be yours.
verses.18:19: Every contribution of the holy things, whatever the sons of Israel set aside for the Lord, I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as an eternal statute; it is a covenant of eternal salt before the Lord for you and for your seed after you."
verses.18:20: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, "In their land you shall not inherit, and there shall be no portion for you among them, because I am your portion and your inheritance in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.18:21: And to the sons of Levi, look, I have given every tithe in Israel as an allotment in return for their services, whatever service they perform in the tent of testimony.
verses.18:22: And the sons of Israel shall no longer come near to the tent of testimony, to bear fatal sin.
verses.18:23: And the Levite himself shall perform the service of the tent of testimony, and they shall bear their sins, an eternal statute for their generations; and in the midst of the sons of Israel they shall not inherit an inheritance.
verses.18:24: For the tithes of the sons of Israel, whatever they set apart for the Lord as a contribution, I have given to the Levites as an allotment; therefore I have said to them, 'In the midst of the sons of Israel they shall not inherit an allotment.'"
verses.18:25: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.18:26: "And to the Levites you shall speak and say to them, 'When you receive from the sons of Israel the tithe that I have given to you from them as an allotment, then you yourselves shall set aside from it a contribution for the Lord, a tithe from the tithe.
verses.18:27: And your contributions shall be reckoned to you as grain from a threshing floor and a contribution from a winepress.
verses.18:28: In this way you also shall set them aside from the contributions of the Lord, from all your tithes, whatever you receive from the sons of Israel, and from them you shall give a contribution to Aaron the priest.
verses.18:29: From all your gifts you shall set aside a contribution for the Lord, or from all the firstfruits, the consecrated part from it.'
verses.18:30: And you shall say to them, 'Whenever you set aside the firstfruit from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as produce from a threshing floor and as produce from a winepress,
verses.18:31: and you shall eat it in every place, you and your households, because this is your wage in return for your services in the tent of testimony;
verses.18:32: and you shall not bear sin because of it, whenever you set aside the firstfruit from it; and the holy things of the sons of Israel you shall not profane, so that you may not die.'"
verses.19:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.19:2: "This is the ordinance of the law, all that the Lord has commanded, saying, 'Speak to the sons of Israel, and let them bring to you a red heifer without blemish, which has no blemish in it and upon which a yoke has not been laid.
verses.19:3: And you shall give it to Eleazar the priest; and they shall lead it outside the camp to a clean place, and they shall slaughter it before him;
verses.19:4: and Eleazar shall take some of its blood, and he shall sprinkle some of its blood opposite the front of the tent of testimony seven times.
verses.19:5: And they shall burn it completely before him; and the hide and its flesh and its blood, together with its dung, shall be burned completely.
verses.19:6: And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet, and they shall throw them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.19:7: And the priest shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and after these things he shall enter into the camp; and the priest shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:8: And the one who burns it completely shall wash his garments and bathe his body, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:9: And a clean person shall gather the ashes of the heifer and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place. And it shall be for the congregation of the sons of Israel for safekeeping; water of sprinkling—it is a purification.
verses.19:10: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his garments, and he shall be unclean until evening; and it shall be for the sons of Israel and for the attached resident aliens an eternal statute.
verses.19:11: The one who touches the dead body of any human person shall be unclean for seven days;
verses.19:12: this one shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day, and shall be clean; but if he is not purified on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
verses.19:13: Everyone who touches the dead body from a human person, if one dies, and is not purified, has defiled the tent of the Lord; that person shall be wiped out from Israel, because water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him; he is unclean; his uncleanness is still in him.
verses.19:14: And this is the law: if a person dies in a house, everyone who enters into the house and all things that are in the house shall be unclean for seven days;
verses.19:15: and every open vessel that does not have a fastening bound upon it is unclean.
verses.19:16: And everyone who touches on the face of the open field one killed or a corpse or a human bone or a grave shall be unclean for seven days.
verses.19:17: And they shall take for the unclean person some of the burned ashes of the purification, and they shall pour living water upon them into a vessel;
verses.19:18: and a clean man shall take hyssop and dip it into the water, and he shall sprinkle upon the house and upon the vessels and upon the persons, however many are there, and upon the one who has touched the human bone or the one killed or the one who has died or the grave;
verses.19:19: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall be purified on the seventh day; and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:20: And a person who becomes defiled and is not purified, that person shall be utterly destroyed from the midst of the congregation, because he has defiled the holy things of the Lord; because water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, he is unclean.
verses.19:21: And it shall be to you an eternal statute; and the one who sprinkles water of sprinkling shall wash his garments, and the one who touches the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening;
verses.19:22: and everything that the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.'"
verses.20:1: And the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.20:2: And there was no water for the congregation, and they gathered together against Moses and Aaron.
verses.20:3: And the people quarreled with Moses, saying, "If only we had died in the destruction of our brothers before the Lord!
verses.20:4: And why have you brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness to kill us and our livestock?
verses.20:5: And why is it that you have brought us up out of Egypt to come to this place? A place where nothing is sown, nor are there figs or vines or pomegranates, nor is there water to drink."
verses.20:6: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the congregation to the door of the tent of testimony, and they fell on their faces; and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
verses.20:7: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.20:8: "Take the staff, and assemble the congregation, you and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before them, and it will give its waters; and you will bring out water for them from the rock, and you will give drink to the congregation and their livestock."
verses.20:9: And Moses took the staff that was before the Lord, just as the Lord commanded.
verses.20:10: And Moses and Aaron assembled the congregation in front of the rock, and he said to them, "Listen to me, you disobedient ones! Shall we bring out water for you from this rock?"
verses.20:11: And raising his hand, Moses struck the rock with the staff twice, and much water came out, and the congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.20:12: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not believe so as to sanctify Me before the sons of Israel, therefore you yourselves will not bring this congregation into the land that I have given them."
verses.20:13: This is the water of dispute, because the sons of Israel quarreled before the Lord, and He was sanctified among them.
verses.20:14: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying, "This is what your brother Israel says: You yourself know all the hardship that has found us;
verses.20:15: and our fathers went down to Egypt, and we sojourned in Egypt for many days, and the Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers;
verses.20:16: and we cried out to the Lord, and the Lord listened to our voice, and sending an angel, He brought us out of Egypt; and now we are in Kadesh, a city at the edge of your borders.
verses.20:17: We will pass through your land; we will not go through fields or through vineyards, nor will we drink water from your cistern; we will travel by the royal road, and we will not turn aside to the right or to the left until we pass through your borders."
verses.20:18: And Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through me; otherwise, I will come out in war to meet you."
verses.20:19: And the sons of Israel said to him, "We will pass along the mountain; and if we drink any of your water, both I and the livestock, I will give you payment; yet the matter is nothing; we will pass along the mountain."
verses.20:20: But he said, "You shall not pass through me." And Edom came out to meet him with a heavy throng and with a strong hand.
verses.20:21: And Edom was not willing to allow Israel to pass through his borders; and Israel turned aside from him.
verses.20:22: And they set out from Kadesh; and the sons of Israel, the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.
verses.20:23: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, at the borders of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.20:24: "Let Aaron be added to his people, for you shall certainly not enter into the land that I have given to the sons of Israel, because you provoked Me at the water of quarreling.
verses.20:25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up onto Mount Hor before the whole congregation;
verses.20:26: and strip Aaron of his robe and clothe Eleazar his son with it, and let Aaron be added and die there."
verses.20:27: And Moses did just as the Lord commanded, and he brought him up onto Mount Hor before the whole congregation.
verses.20:28: And he stripped Aaron of his garments and clothed Eleazar his son with them; and Aaron died on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
verses.20:29: And the whole congregation saw that Aaron had departed; and the entire house of Israel wept for Aaron thirty days.
verses.21:1: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived along the wilderness, heard—for Israel had come by the way of Atharim—and he fought against Israel, and they carried off captives from among them.
verses.21:2: And Israel vowed a vow to the Lord and said, "If You deliver this people under my hand, I will devote them and their cities to destruction."
verses.21:3: And the Lord listened to the voice of Israel and delivered the Canaanite under his hand; and he devoted him and his cities to destruction, and they called the name of that place Anathema.
verses.21:4: And setting out from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, they went around the land of Edom; and the people lost heart on the way.
verses.21:5: And the people spoke against God and against Moses, saying, "Why is it that you have brought us out of Egypt to kill us in the wilderness? For there is no bread and no water, and our soul loathes the empty bread."
verses.21:6: And the Lord sent the deadly serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many people of the sons of Israel died.
verses.21:7: And the people came to Moses and said, "We have sinned, because we spoke against the Lord and against you; pray, therefore, to the Lord, and let Him take away the serpent from us."
verses.21:8: And Moses prayed to the Lord for the people. And the Lord said to Moses, "Make for yourself a serpent, and set it on a standard; and it will be that if a serpent bites a person, everyone who has been bitten, when he sees it, will live."
verses.21:9: And Moses made a bronze serpent, and set it up on a standard; and it happened that whenever a serpent bit a person, and he looked upon the bronze serpent, he lived.
verses.21:10: And the sons of Israel set out and camped in Oboth.
verses.21:11: And setting out from Oboth, they camped in Chalgai on the far side, in the wilderness that faces Moab toward the rising of the sun.
verses.21:12: From there they set out and camped in the valley of Zered.
verses.21:13: Setting out from there, they camped on the other side of the Arnon in the wilderness, which extends from the borders of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorite.
verses.21:14: Therefore it is said in the book War of the Lord: "He set Zoob ablaze and the streams of the Arnon;
verses.21:15: and He appointed the streams to settle Ar, and it adjoins the borders of Moab."
verses.21:16: And from there, the well; this is the well about which the Lord said to Moses, "Gather the people, and I will give them water to drink."
verses.21:17: Then Israel sang this song over the well: "Strike up the song to it:
verses.21:18: A well—princes dug it, kings of nations hewed it out, in their kingdom, when they ruled over them."
verses.21:19: And from the well to Manthanain; and from Manthanain to Manael; and from Manael to Bamoth; and from Bamoth to Ianen, which is in the plain of Moab, from the top of the hewn rock, which looks toward the face of the wilderness.
verses.21:20: And Moses sent envoys to Sihon king of the Amorites with words of peace, saying,
verses.21:21: "We will pass through your land; we will travel along the road; we will not turn aside either into a field or into a vineyard,
verses.21:22: we will not drink water from your well; we will travel by the royal road until we pass through your borders."
verses.21:23: And Sihon did not allow Israel to pass through his borders; and Sihon gathered all his people, and went out to engage Israel in battle in the wilderness; and he came to Jahaz and engaged Israel in battle.
verses.21:24: And Israel struck him with the slaughter of the sword, and they gained mastery over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon; for Jazer is the border of the sons of Ammon.
verses.21:25: And Israel took all these cities; and Israel settled in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all those adjoining it.
verses.21:26: For Heshbon is the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites; and he had fought against the king of Moab previously, and they took all his land from Aroer to the Arnon.
verses.21:27: Therefore the riddle-makers will say, "Come to Heshbon, that the city of Sihon may be built and prepared;
verses.21:28: for fire went out from Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon; and it devoured as far as Moab, and swallowed up the pillars of the Arnon.
verses.21:29: Woe to you, Moab! You have perished, people of Chemosh! Their sons were given over to escape safely, and their daughters as captives, to the king of the Amorites, Sihon.
verses.21:30: And their seed will perish, Heshbon as far as Dibon, and the women still further kindled fire upon Moab."
verses.21:31: Now Israel settled in all the cities of the Amorites.
verses.21:32: And Moses sent to spy out Jazer, and they captured it and its villages, and drove out the Amorite who lived there.
verses.21:33: And turning, they went up by the way to Bashan; and Og king of Bashan came out to meet them, and all his people, for battle at Edrei.
verses.21:34: And the Lord said to Moses, "Do not fear him, for into your hands I have delivered him and all his people and all his land; and you shall do to him just as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon."
verses.21:35: And he struck him and his sons and all his people, until he left no survivor of his; and they inherited their land.
verses.22:1: And the sons of Israel set out and encamped on the west of Moab, beside the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.22:2: And Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites,
verses.22:3: and Moab feared the people greatly, because they were many; and Moab was filled with loathing at the presence of the sons of Israel.
verses.22:4: And Moab said to the council of elders of Midian, "Now this assembly will lick up all those around us, just as a calf licks up the greenery from the field." Now Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.22:5: So he sent envoys to Balaam son of Beor at Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the sons of his people, to summon him, saying, "Look, a people has come out from Egypt, and see, it has covered the face of the land, and it is settled right next to me.
verses.22:6: And now come, curse this people for me, because it is stronger than we are, if we may be able to strike some of them, and I will drive them out of the land; for I know that those whom you bless are blessed, and those whom you curse are cursed."
verses.22:7: And the council of elders of Moab and the council of elders of Midian went, with the divinations in their hands; and they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.
verses.22:8: And he said to them, "Stay here for the night, and I will answer you with the matters that the Lord speaks to me." So the officials of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.22:9: And God came to Balaam and said to him, "Why are these men with you?"
verses.22:10: And Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent them to me, saying,
verses.22:11: 'Look, a people has come out from Egypt, and see, it has covered the face of the land, and it is settled right next to me; and now come, curse it for me, if perhaps I will be able to strike it and drive it out from the land.'"
verses.22:12: And God said to Balaam, "You shall not go with them, nor shall you curse the people, for it is blessed."
verses.22:13: And Balaam got up in the morning and said to the officials of Balak, "Hurry back to your lord; God does not permit me to go with you."
verses.22:14: And the officials of Moab got up and came to Balak and said, "Balaam is not willing to go with us."
verses.22:15: And Balak again sent officials, more numerous and more honorable than these.
verses.22:16: And they came to Balaam and said to him, "Thus says Balak son of Zippor: 'I urge you, do not hesitate to come to me,
verses.22:17: for I will honor you with great honor, and whatever you say I will do for you; and come, pronounce a curse on this people for me.'"
verses.22:18: And Balaam answered and said to the officials of Balak, "If Balak should give me his house full of silver and gold, I will not be able to transgress the word of the Lord God, to make it small or great in my mind.
verses.22:19: And now you also stay here this night, and I will know what more the Lord will speak to me."
verses.22:20: And God came to Balaam and said to him, "If these men are here to summon you, get up and follow them; yet the word that I speak to you, this you shall do."
verses.22:21: And Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the officials of Moab.
verses.22:22: And God became furious with anger because he went, and the angel of God stood up to oppose him; and he himself was riding on his donkey, and two of his servants were with him.
verses.22:23: And when the donkey saw the angel of God standing in opposition on the road, with the sword drawn in his hand, the donkey turned aside from her road and went into the field; and he struck the donkey with the staff to set her straight on the road.
verses.22:24: And the angel of God stood in the furrows of the vineyards, a fence on this side and a fence on that side;
verses.22:25: and when the donkey saw the angel of God, she pressed him against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot, and he whipped her once again.
verses.22:26: And the angel of God went on further and took his stand in a narrow place, where there was no room to turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.22:27: And when the donkey saw the angel of God, she sank down underneath Balaam; and Balaam became enraged and kept beating the donkey with the staff.
verses.22:28: And God opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me this third time?"
verses.22:29: And Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have mocked me; and if I had a sword in my hand, I would already have run you through."
verses.22:30: And the donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden from your youth until this day? Have I, in utter disregard, done this to you?" And he said, "No."
verses.22:31: Then God uncovered the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in opposition on the road, with the sword drawn in his hand; and bowing low, he prostrated himself on his face.
verses.22:32: And the angel of God said to him, "Why have you struck your donkey this third time? And look, I came out to oppose you, because your way is not pleasing before me. And when the donkey saw me, she turned aside from me this third time;
verses.22:33: and if she had not turned aside, then by now I would have killed you, yet I would have spared her."
verses.22:34: And Balaam said to the angel of the Lord, "I have sinned, for I did not know that you were standing in opposition to me on the road to meet me; and now, if it does not please you, I will turn back."
verses.22:35: And the angel of God said to Balaam, "Go with the men; only the word that I speak to you, this you shall be careful to speak." So Balaam went with the officials of Balak.
verses.22:36: And when Balak heard that Balaam had arrived, he went out to meet him at a city of Moab, which is on the borders of the Arnon, which is at the edge of the borders.
verses.22:37: And Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send to you to summon you? Why did you not come to me? Will I not truly be able to honor you?"
verses.22:38: And Balaam said to Balak, "Look, I have come to you now; will I be able to speak anything? The word that God puts into my mouth, this I will speak."
verses.22:39: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Cities of Villages.
verses.22:40: And Balak sacrificed sheep and calves, and sent to Balaam and to the officials who were with him.
verses.22:41: And morning came, and Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the pillar of Baal, and from there he showed him a part of the people.
verses.23:1: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven calves and seven rams for me here."
verses.23:2: And Balak did just as Balaam had told him, and he offered up a calf and a ram on the altar.
verses.23:3: And Balaam said to Balak, "Stand beside your sacrifice, and I will go, if perhaps God will appear to meet me; and whatever word He shows me I will report to you." And Balak stood beside his sacrifice;
verses.23:4: and Balaam went to inquire of God, and he went straight on. And God appeared to Balaam, and Balaam said to Him, "I have prepared the seven altars, and I have brought up a calf and a ram onto the altar."
verses.23:5: And God put a word into Balaam's mouth and said, "Return to Balak, and this is how you shall speak."
verses.23:6: And he returned to him; and he was standing beside his burnt offerings, and all the officials of Moab were with him. And the Spirit of God came upon him;
verses.23:7: and taking up his parable, he said, "From Mesopotamia Balak sent for me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east, saying, 'Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, pronounce a curse on Israel for me.'
verses.23:8: How shall I curse one whom the Lord does not curse? Or how shall I curse one whom God does not curse?
verses.23:9: For from the summit of mountains I will see him, and from hills I will observe him. Look, a people will dwell alone and will not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.23:10: Who has precisely calculated the seed of Jacob? And who will number the clans of Israel? May my soul die among the souls of the righteous, and may my seed become like the seed of these."
verses.23:11: And Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I have summoned you to curse my enemies, and look, you have blessed them with a blessing."
verses.23:12: And Balaam said to Balak, "Whatever God puts into my mouth, will I not be careful to speak this?"
verses.23:13: And Balak said to him, "Come again with me to another place, from where you will not see it, except that you will see a part of it, while all of them you will certainly not see; and curse it for me from there."
verses.23:14: And he took him to a field's lookout, to the summit of the Hewn Place, and built seven altars there, and brought up a calf and a ram onto the altar.
verses.23:15: And Balaam said to Balak, "Stand beside your sacrifice, and I will go to inquire of God."
verses.23:16: And God met Balaam and put a word into his mouth and said, "Return to Balak, and these things you shall speak."
verses.23:17: And he returned to him; and he was standing beside his burnt offering, and all the officials of Moab were with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the Lord spoken?"
verses.23:18: And taking up his parable, he said, "Rise, Balak, and hear; give ear, witness, son of Zippor.
verses.23:19: God is not like a man, to be misled, nor like a son of man, to be threatened; having spoken, will He not do it? Will He speak and not stand by it?
verses.23:20: Look, I have been brought to bless; I will bless, and I will certainly not turn back.
verses.23:21: There will be no hardship in Jacob, nor will distress be seen in Israel; the Lord his God is with him, the glories of rulers are in him.
verses.23:22: God is the One who brought them out of Egypt; his is like the glory of a unicorn.
verses.23:23: For there is no augury in Jacob, nor divination in Israel. In due time it will be told to Jacob and to Israel what God will accomplish.
verses.23:24: Look, a people will rise up like a lion cub, and like a lion it will exult; it will not sleep until it eats prey, and it will drink the blood of the wounded."
verses.23:25: And Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse it for me with curses, nor bless it at all."
verses.23:26: And Balaam answered and said to Balak, "Did I not speak to you, saying, 'The word that God speaks, this I will do'?"
verses.23:27: And Balak said to Balaam, "Come, let me take you to another place; if it will please God, then curse it for me from there."
verses.23:28: And Balak took Balaam to the summit of Peor, which stretches out toward the wilderness.
verses.23:29: And Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven calves and seven rams for me here."
verses.23:30: And Balak did just as Balaam had told him, and he offered up a calf and a ram on the altar.
verses.24:1: And when Balaam saw that it was good before the Lord to bless Israel, he did not go as was customary to meet the omens, and he turned his face toward the wilderness.
verses.24:2: And Balaam lifted up his eyes and observed Israel encamped by tribes, and the Spirit of God came to be in him.
verses.24:3: And taking up his parable, he said, "Balaam son of Beor says, the man who truly sees says,
verses.24:4: the one who hears the oracles of God says, who saw a vision of God in sleep, his eyes uncovered:
verses.24:5: How beautiful are your houses, Jacob, your tents, Israel,
verses.24:6: like shady valleys, and like a garden beside rivers, and like tents that the Lord pitched, like cedars beside waters.
verses.24:7: A man will come forth from his seed, and he will rule over many nations; and a kingdom will be exalted higher than Gog, and his kingdom will be increased.
verses.24:8: God led him out of Egypt; like the glory of a unicorn is his; he will devour the nations of his enemies, and he will drain the marrow from their fat parts, and with his arrows he will shoot down an enemy.
verses.24:9: He lay down and rested like a lion and like a cub; who will rouse him? Those who bless you are blessed, and those who curse you are cursed."
verses.24:10: And Balak became angry with Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, "I have called you to curse my enemy, and look, you have surely blessed him this third time.
verses.24:11: Now therefore, flee to your place. I said, 'I will honor you,' and now the Lord has deprived you of glory."
verses.24:12: And Balaam said to Balak, "Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
verses.24:13: 'If Balak should give me his house full of silver and gold, I will not be able to transgress the word of the Lord, to make it evil or good on my own; whatever things God says, those I will speak'?
verses.24:14: And now, look, I am hurrying away to my place; come, I will advise you what this people will do to your people at the end of the days."
verses.24:15: And taking up his parable, he said,
verses.24:16: "Balaam son of Beor says, the true man who sees says, hearing the oracles of God, knowing knowledge from the Most High, and having seen a vision of God in sleep, his eyes uncovered:
verses.24:17: I will show to him, yet not now; I pronounce blessed, yet he does not draw near: a star will rise out of Jacob, and a man will arise out of Israel, and he will shatter the leaders of Moab, and he will plunder all the sons of Seth.
verses.24:18: And Edom will be an inheritance, and Esau his enemy will be an inheritance; and Israel acted in strength.
verses.24:19: And one will be raised up out of Jacob, and will destroy anyone escaping from a city."
verses.24:20: And seeing Amalek and taking up his parable, he said, "Amalek is the beginning of the nations, and their seed will perish."
verses.24:21: And seeing the Kenite and taking up his parable, he said, "Strong is your dwelling place; and if you place your nest in a rock,
verses.24:22: and if a nest of craftiness comes to be for Beor, Assyrians will take you captive."
verses.24:23: And seeing Og and taking up his parable, he said, "Alas, alas, who will live when God establishes these things?
verses.24:24: And one will come forth from the hand of the Kittim, and they will afflict Asshur, and they will afflict the Hebrews, and they themselves will perish together."
verses.24:25: And Balaam rose up and departed, returning to his place; and Balak departed to his own home.
verses.25:1: And Israel lodged at Shittim; and the people were profaned by committing sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab.
verses.25:2: And they invited them to the sacrifices of their idols, and the people ate from their sacrifices and bowed down to their idols,
verses.25:3: and Israel was initiated to Baal-peor; and the Lord became angry with fury against Israel.
verses.25:4: And the Lord said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of the people and make a public example of them to the Lord facing the sun, and the anger of the Lord will turn away from Israel."
verses.25:5: And Moses said to the tribes of Israel, "Each of you, kill his own relative who has been initiated to Baal-peor."
verses.25:6: And look, a man of the sons of Israel came and brought his brother to the Midianite woman before Moses and before the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, while they were weeping beside the door of the tent of testimony.
verses.25:7: And when Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw this, he rose up from the midst of the congregation, and taking a spear in his hand,
verses.25:8: he went in behind the Israelite man into the furnace, and pierced both of them, both the Israelite man and the woman through her womb; and the plague ceased from the sons of Israel.
verses.25:9: And those who had died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.25:10: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:11: "Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has caused My fury to cease from the sons of Israel by being zealous with My zeal among them, and I did not consume the sons of Israel in My zeal.
verses.25:12: So say, 'Look, I am giving him a covenant of peace,
verses.25:13: and it will be for him and for his seed after him an eternal covenant of priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the sons of Israel.'"
verses.25:14: Now the name of the Israelite man who had been struck, who was struck with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, son of Salmon, ruler of a father's house of the Simeonites.
verses.25:15: And the name of the Midianite woman who had been struck was Cozbi, daughter of Zur, ruler of the nation of Ommoth; he is of a father's house of the Midianites.
verses.25:16: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying,
verses.25:17: 'Be hostile to the Midianites and strike them,
verses.25:18: because they themselves are hostile to you with deceit, in all the ways they deceive you on account of Peor, and on account of Cozbi, daughter of a ruler of Midian, their sister, who was struck on the day of the plague on account of Peor.'"
verses.26:1: And it happened after the plague that the Lord spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, saying,
verses.26:2: "Take the count of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, according to their fathers' houses, everyone who goes out to draw up for battle in Israel."
verses.26:3: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke in Araboth of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying,
verses.26:4: "From twenty years old and upward, just as the Lord commanded Moses, you and the sons of Israel who came out of Egypt."
verses.26:5: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. Now the sons of Reuben were: Hanoch, and the clan of Hanoch; of Pallu, the clan of the Palluites;
verses.26:6: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the clan of the Carmites.
verses.26:7: These are the clans of Reuben; and their numbering was forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.26:8: And the sons of Pallu: Eliab.
verses.26:9: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These were the summoned men of the congregation; these are the ones who rose up against Moses and Aaron in the congregation of Korah, in the uprising against the Lord.
verses.26:10: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korah in his congregation, when the fire devoured the two hundred and fifty, and they became a sign.
verses.26:11: However, the sons of Korah did not die.
verses.26:12: And the sons of Simeon, the clan of the sons of Simeon: of Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the clan of the Jachinites;
verses.26:13: of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the clan of the Shaulites.
verses.26:14: These are the clans of Simeon from their numbering, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.26:15: Now the sons of Judah were Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.26:16: And the sons of Judah according to their clans were: of Shelah, the clan of the Shelanites; of Perez, the clan of Perez; of Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites.
verses.26:17: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; of Jamun, the clan of the Jamunites.
verses.26:18: These are the clans of Judah according to their registration, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.26:19: And the sons of Issachar according to their clans: of Tola, the clan of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the clan of the Puvaites;
verses.26:20: of Jashub, the clan of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the clan of the Shimronites.
verses.26:21: These are the clans of Issachar from their numbering, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.26:22: The sons of Zebulun according to their clans: of Sered, the clan of the Seredites; of Elon, the clan of the Elonites; of Allel, the clan of the Allelites.
verses.26:23: These are the clans of Zebulun from their numbering, sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.26:24: The sons of Gad according to their clans: of Zephon, the clan of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the clan of the Haggites; of Shuni, the clan of the Shunites;
verses.26:25: of Ozni, the clan of the Oznites; of Addi, the clan of the Addites;
verses.26:26: of Arodi, the clan of the Arodites; of Ariel, the clan of the Arielites.
verses.26:27: These are the clans of the sons of Gad from their numbering, forty-four thousand five hundred.
verses.26:28: The sons of Asher according to their clans: of Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites; of Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the clan of the Beriites.
verses.26:29: Of Heber, the clan of the Heberites; of Melliel, the clan of the Mellielites.
verses.26:30: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Kara.
verses.26:31: These are the clans of Asher from their numbering, forty-three thousand six hundred.
verses.26:32: The sons of Joseph according to their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.26:33: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the clan of the Machirites; and Machir fathered Gilead; of Gilead, the clan of the Gileadites.
verses.26:34: And these were the sons of Gilead: Ahiezer, the clan of the Ahiezerites; of Helek, the clan of the Helekites;
verses.26:35: of Asriel, the clan of the Asrielites; of Shechem, the clan of the Shechemites;
verses.26:36: of Symaer, the clan of the Symaerites; and Hepher, the clan of the Hepherites.
verses.26:37: And Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, but only daughters; and these were the names of the daughters of Zelophehad: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.26:38: These are the clans of Manasseh from their numbering, fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.26:39: And these were the sons of Ephraim: of Shuthelah, the clan of the Shuthelahites; of Tanach, the clan of the Tanachites.
verses.26:40: These were the sons of Shuthelah: of Eden, the clan of the Edenites.
verses.26:41: These are the clans of Ephraim from their numbering, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the clans of the sons of Joseph according to their clans.
verses.26:42: The sons of Benjamin according to their clans: of Bela, the clan of the Belaites; of Asyber, the clan of the Asyberites; of Jachiran, the clan of the Jachiranites;
verses.26:43: of Sophan, the clan of the Sophanites.
verses.26:44: And the sons of Bela were Adar and Naamani.
verses.26:45: These are the sons of Benjamin according to their clans from their numbering, thirty-five thousand five hundred.
verses.26:46: And the sons of Dan according to their clans: of Sami, the clan of the Samites. These are the clans of Dan according to their clans.
verses.26:47: All the clans of Sami according to their registration were sixty-four thousand six hundred.
verses.26:48: The sons of Naphtali according to their clans: of Sael, the clan of the Saelites; of Guni, the clan of the Gunites;
verses.26:49: of Jezer, the clan of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the clan of the Shillemites.
verses.26:50: These are the clans of Naphtali from their numbering, thirty thousand three hundred.
verses.26:51: This is the numbering of the sons of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.26:52: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.26:53: "To these the land shall be divided to inherit by the number of names;
verses.26:54: to the more numerous you shall increase the inheritance, and to the fewer you shall decrease their inheritance; to each one, just as they were numbered, their inheritance shall be given.
verses.26:55: Through lots the land shall be divided by the names; according to the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit;
verses.26:56: by the lot you shall divide their inheritance between many and few."
verses.26:57: And the sons of Levi according to their clans: of Gershon, the clan of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the clan of the Kohathites; of Merari, the clan of the Merarites.
verses.26:58: These are the clans of the sons of Levi: the clan of the Libnites, the clan of the Hebronites, the clan of Korah, and the clan of the Mushites. And Kohath fathered Amram.
verses.26:59: And the name of his wife was Jochebed, daughter of Levi, who bore these to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron, Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.26:60: And to Aaron were born Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.26:61: And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.26:62: And from their numbering they were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not numbered together in the midst of the sons of Israel, because no allotment is given to them in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.26:63: And this is the numbering of Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the sons of Israel in Araboth of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.26:64: And among these there was not a man of those who had been numbered by Moses and Aaron when they numbered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.26:65: For the Lord had said to him, "They will certainly die in the wilderness." And not even one was left of them, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.27:1: And the daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, of the clan of Manasseh of the sons of Joseph, came forward, and these are their names: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah;
verses.27:2: and standing before Moses and before Eleazar the priest and before the rulers and before all the congregation at the doorway of the tent of testimony, they said,
verses.27:3: "Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the midst of the congregation that banded together before the Lord in the congregation of Korah, for he died because of his sin, and he had no sons. Let the name of our father not be blotted out from the midst of his clan because he has no son; give us a possession in the midst of our father's brothers."
verses.27:4: And Moses brought their case before the Lord.
verses.27:5: And the Lord spoke to Moses,
verses.27:6: saying, "The daughters of Zelophehad have spoken rightly; you shall give them as a gift a possession of inheritance in the midst of their father's brothers, and you shall transfer their father's allotment to them.
verses.27:7: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel,
verses.27:8: saying, 'If a man dies and has no son, you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter;
verses.27:9: and if he has no daughter, you shall give the inheritance to his brother;
verses.27:10: and if he has no brothers, you shall give the inheritance to his father's brother;
verses.27:11: and if his father has no brothers, you shall give the inheritance to the relative nearest to him from his tribe; he shall inherit what is his.'" And this shall be to the sons of Israel a statute of judgment, just as the Lord directed Moses.
verses.27:12: And the Lord said to Moses, "Go up to the mountain on the other side, this Mount Nebo, and see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel as a possession;
verses.27:13: and you shall see it, and you also shall be added to your people, just as Aaron your brother was added on Mount Hor,
verses.27:14: because you transgressed My word in the wilderness of Zin when the congregation resisted, to sanctify Me; you did not sanctify Me at the water before them." This is the water of contention in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.27:15: And Moses said to the Lord,
verses.27:16: "May the Lord, the God of the spirits and of all flesh, appoint a man over this congregation,
verses.27:17: who will go out before them and who will come in before them, and who will lead them out and who will bring them in, and the congregation of the Lord will not be like sheep that have no shepherd."
verses.27:18: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, "Take to yourself Joshua son of Nun, a man who has spirit in himself, and you shall lay your hands on him;
verses.27:19: and you shall set him before Eleazar the priest, and you shall command him before all the congregation, and you shall give a command concerning him before them;
verses.27:20: and you shall place some of your glory on him, so that the sons of Israel may listen to him.
verses.27:21: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, and they shall inquire of him for the judgment of the Manifestations before the Lord; at his word they shall go out and at his word they shall come in, he and the sons of Israel with one accord and the whole congregation."
verses.27:22: And Moses did just as the Lord commanded him; and taking Joshua, he set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation,
verses.27:23: and he laid his hands on him and appointed him, just as the Lord directed Moses.
verses.28:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.28:2: "Command the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'My gifts, My offerings, My fire offerings, for an aroma of sweet fragrance, you shall be careful to offer to Me at My feasts.'
verses.28:3: And you shall say to them, 'These are the fire offerings which you shall bring to the Lord: two year-old lambs without blemish each day for a whole burnt offering continually;
verses.28:4: the one lamb you shall prepare in the morning, and the second lamb you shall prepare toward evening.
verses.28:5: And you shall prepare one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sacrifice, mixed with oil, one-fourth of a hin,
verses.28:6: a continual whole burnt offering, which was made on Mount Sinai for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord;
verses.28:7: and its drink offering, one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in the holy place you shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the Lord.
verses.28:8: And the second lamb you shall prepare toward evening; according to its sacrifice and according to its drink offering you shall prepare it for an aroma of sweet fragrance for the Lord.
verses.28:9: And on the Sabbath day you shall bring two year-old lambs without blemish, and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice, and a drink offering,
verses.28:10: a whole burnt offering of the Sabbath on the Sabbaths, in addition to the perpetual whole burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.28:11: And at the new moons you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord: two young bulls from the cattle and one ram, seven year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.28:12: three-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for each young bull, and two-tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for the one ram,
verses.28:13: one-tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance, a fire offering to the Lord.
verses.28:14: Their drink offering shall be one-half of a hin for each young bull, and one-third of a hin shall be for the one ram, and one-fourth of a hin of wine shall be for each lamb; this is the whole burnt offering month by month for the months of the year.
verses.28:15: And one male goat from the goats for a sin offering for the Lord; it shall be prepared in addition to the perpetual whole burnt offering, and its drink offering.
verses.28:16: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Passover of the Lord.
verses.28:17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a feast; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
verses.28:18: And the first day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall not do any servile work;
verses.28:19: and you shall bring whole burnt offerings, fire offerings to the Lord: two young bulls from the cattle, one ram, seven year-old lambs; they shall be without blemish for you;
verses.28:20: and their sacrifice shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for each young bull and two-tenths for the one ram,
verses.28:21: one-tenth each you shall prepare for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.28:22: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you,
verses.28:23: besides the perpetual whole burnt offering of the morning, which is a continual whole burnt offering.
verses.28:24: You shall prepare these things in the same manner each day for the seven days, a gift, a fire offering for an aroma of sweet fragrance for the Lord; in addition to the perpetual whole burnt offering you shall prepare its drink offering.
verses.28:25: And the seventh day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall not do any servile work on it.
verses.28:26: And on the day of the new produce, when you offer to the Lord a new sacrifice of the Weeks, it shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall not do any servile work.
verses.28:27: And you shall bring whole burnt offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord: two young bulls from the cattle, one ram, seven year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.28:28: their sacrifice shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for each young bull and two-tenths for the one ram,
verses.28:29: one-tenth each for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.28:30: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you, besides the whole burnt offering
verses.28:31: that is perpetual; and you shall prepare their sacrifice for Me (they shall be without blemish for you), and their drink offerings.'"
verses.29:1: And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, there shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall not do any servile work. It shall be a day of signaling for you.
verses.29:2: And you shall prepare whole burnt offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord: one young bull from the cattle, one ram, seven year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.29:3: their sacrifice: fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the one young bull and two tenths for the one ram,
verses.29:4: one tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs;
verses.29:5: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you,
verses.29:6: besides the whole burnt offerings of the new moon, and their sacrifices and their drink offerings, and the continual whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices and their drink offerings, according to their regulation, for an aroma of sweet fragrance for the Lord.
verses.29:7: And on the tenth of this month there shall be a holy convocation for you; and you shall afflict your souls, and you shall not do any work.
verses.29:8: And you shall offer whole burnt offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance, fire offerings to the Lord: one young bull from the cattle, one ram, seven year-old lambs; they shall be without blemish for you.
verses.29:9: Their sacrifice: fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the one young bull and two tenths for the one ram,
verses.29:10: one tenth for each lamb, for the seven lambs;
verses.29:11: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, to make atonement for you, besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual whole burnt offering, its sacrifice and its drink offering, according to the regulation, for an aroma of sweet fragrance, a fire offering to the Lord.
verses.29:12: And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month there shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall not do any servile work, and celebrate it as a festival of the Lord for seven days.
verses.29:13: And you shall present whole burnt offerings, fire offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance for the Lord: on the first day, thirteen young bulls from the cattle, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs; they shall be without blemish.
verses.29:14: Their sacrifices: fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each young bull, for the thirteen young bulls, and two tenths for each ram, for the two rams,
verses.29:15: one tenth for each lamb, for the fourteen lambs;
verses.29:16: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:17: And on the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.29:18: their sacrifice and their drink offering for the young bulls and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their regulation;
verses.29:19: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:20: On the third day: eleven young bulls, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.29:21: their sacrifice and their drink offering for the young bulls and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their regulation;
verses.29:22: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:23: On the fourth day: ten young bulls, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.29:24: their sacrifices and their drink offerings for the young bulls and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their regulation;
verses.29:25: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:26: On the fifth day: nine young bulls, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.29:27: their sacrifices and their drink offerings for the young bulls and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their regulation;
verses.29:28: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:29: On the sixth day: eight young bulls, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.29:30: their sacrifices and their drink offerings for the young bulls and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their regulation;
verses.29:31: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:32: On the seventh day: seven young bulls, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs;
verses.29:33: their sacrifices and their drink offerings for the young bulls and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their regulation;
verses.29:34: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:35: And on the eighth day there shall be a closing festival for you; you shall not do any servile work on it.
verses.29:36: And you shall present whole burnt offerings for an aroma of sweet fragrance, fire offerings to the Lord: one young bull, one ram, seven year-old lambs without blemish;
verses.29:37: their sacrifices and their drink offerings for the young bull and for the ram and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their regulation;
verses.29:38: and one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, besides the continual whole burnt offering, their sacrifices and their drink offerings.
verses.29:39: These things you shall prepare for the Lord at your festivals, besides your vows and your freewill offerings, and your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your drink offerings, and your deliverance offerings.
verses.30:1: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.30:2: And Moses spoke to the leaders of the tribes of Israel, saying, "This is the word that the Lord has prescribed:
verses.30:3: Any man who vows a vow to the Lord, or swears an oath with an obligation, or imposes an obligation concerning his soul shall not profane his word; he shall do all that goes out from his mouth.
verses.30:4: Now if a woman vows a vow to the Lord, or imposes an obligation in her father's house in her youth,
verses.30:5: and her father hears her vows and her obligations that she imposed upon her soul, and her father keeps silent toward her, then all her vows shall stand, and all the obligations that she imposed upon her soul shall remain upon her.
verses.30:6: But if her father firmly disapproves on the day he hears all her vows and the obligations that she imposed upon her soul, they shall not stand; and the Lord will cleanse her, because her father disapproved.
verses.30:7: And if she indeed marries a husband, and her vows are upon her according to the utterance of her lips, which she imposed upon her soul,
verses.30:8: and her husband hears and keeps silent toward her on the day he hears, then so all her vows shall stand, and her obligations that she imposed upon her soul shall stand.
verses.30:9: But if her husband firmly disapproves on the day he hears, all her vows and her obligations that she imposed upon her soul shall not remain, because her husband disapproved of her; and the Lord will cleanse her.
verses.30:10: And the vow of a widow and of a divorced woman, all that she vows upon her soul, shall remain upon her.
verses.30:11: And if her vow or the obligation upon her soul with an oath is in her husband's house,
verses.30:12: and her husband hears, and keeps silent toward her and does not disapprove of her, then all her vows shall stand, and all her obligations that she imposed upon her soul shall stand against her.
verses.30:13: But if her husband completely removes them on the day he hears, all that goes out from her lips concerning her vows and concerning the obligations upon her soul shall not remain upon her; her husband has removed them, and the Lord will cleanse her.
verses.30:14: Every vow and every binding oath to afflict a soul, her husband may establish it for her, and her husband may remove it.
verses.30:15: But if he keeps completely silent toward her from day to day, then he shall establish for her all her vows, and he shall establish for her the obligations that are upon her, because he kept silent toward her on the day he heard.
verses.30:16: But if he completely removes them from her after the day he heard, then he shall bear his sin."
verses.30:17: These are the ordinances that the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and a daughter in youth in a father's house.
verses.31:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:2: "Avenge the vengeance of the sons of Israel on the Midianites, and afterward you will be added to your people."
verses.31:3: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Arm men from among you to draw up for battle before the Lord against Midian, to render vengeance from the Lord to Midian.
verses.31:4: A thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe; from all the tribes of Israel send them to draw up for battle."
verses.31:5: And they counted out from the thousands of Israel a thousand from a tribe: twelve thousand, armed for battle array.
verses.31:6: And Moses sent them out, a thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe, with their force, and Phinehas son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest; and the holy vessels and the trumpets of signaling were in their hands.
verses.31:7: And they drew up for battle against Midian, just as the Lord commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
verses.31:8: And they killed the kings of Midian along with those struck down among them: Evi, Zur, Rekem, Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian; and they killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword together with those struck down among them.
verses.31:9: And they took as plunder the women of Midian and their dependents, and their livestock and all their possessions and their wealth they plundered.
verses.31:10: And they burned with fire all their cities in their dwellings, and their encampments.
verses.31:11: And they took all the plunder and all their spoils, from human to animal.
verses.31:12: And they brought to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to all the sons of Israel the captives and the spoils and the plunder, to the camp at Araboth of Moab, which is by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
verses.31:13: And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
verses.31:14: And Moses became angry with the overseers of the force, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, who were coming from the battle array of the war.
verses.31:15: And Moses said to them, "Why have you kept every female alive?
verses.31:16: For these were to the sons of Israel, according to the word of Balaam, a cause to turn away and disregard the word of the Lord because of Peor, and the plague occurred in the congregation of the Lord.
verses.31:17: And now kill every male among all the dependents, and kill every woman who has known the bed of a male.
verses.31:18: All the dependents among the women who have not known the bed of a male, keep them alive.
verses.31:19: And you, encamp outside the camp seven days; everyone who has killed and whoever touches the one struck down shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives;
verses.31:20: and every garment and every leather article and every work of goat's hair and every wooden article you shall purify."
verses.31:21: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the force who were coming from the battle array of the war, "This is the ordinance of the law that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.31:22: Besides the gold and the silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin,
verses.31:23: every item shall pass through fire, and it shall be cleansed; yet it shall be purified with the water of purification. And all things that do not pass through fire shall pass through water.
verses.31:24: And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be cleansed; and after these things you shall enter the camp."
verses.31:25: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take the total of the spoils of the captivity, from human to animal, you and Eleazar the priest and the leaders of the ancestral houses of the congregation;
verses.31:27: and you shall divide the spoils between the warriors who go out to the battle array and all the congregation.
verses.31:28: And you shall set apart a tribute for the Lord from the fighting men who have gone out to the battle array: one soul out of five hundred, from the people and from the livestock and from the cattle and from the sheep and from the goats;
verses.31:29: and from their half you shall take and give to Eleazar the priest the firstfruits of the Lord;
verses.31:30: and from the half belonging to the sons of Israel, you shall take one out of fifty, from the people and from the cattle and from the sheep and from the donkeys and from all the livestock, and you shall give them to the Levites who keep the watches in the tent of the Lord."
verses.31:31: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.31:32: And the remainder of the plunder that the fighting men had plundered was, from the sheep, six hundred seventy-five thousand;
verses.31:35: and human souls, from the women who had not known the bed of a man, all the souls: thirty-two thousand.
verses.31:36: And the half-share, the portion of those who had gone out to the war, was, from the number of the sheep, three hundred thirty-five thousand five hundred.
verses.31:37: And the tribute for the Lord from the sheep was six hundred seventy-five;
verses.31:38: and cattle, thirty-six thousand, and the tribute for the Lord, seventy-two;
verses.31:39: and donkeys, thirty thousand five hundred, and the tribute for the Lord, sixty-one;
verses.31:40: and human souls, sixteen thousand, and their tribute for the Lord, thirty-two souls.
verses.31:41: And Moses gave the tribute for the Lord, the set-apart offering of God, to Eleazar the priest, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.31:42: From the half-share of the sons of Israel, whom Moses separated from the fighting men;
verses.31:43: and the half-share from the congregation was, from the sheep, three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred,
verses.31:47: And Moses took from the half-share of the sons of Israel the one out of fifty, from the people and from the livestock, and gave them to the Levites who keep the watches of the tent of the Lord, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.31:48: And all those appointed over the divisions of thousands of the force, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, approached Moses,
verses.31:49: and they said to Moses, "Your servants have taken the total of the fighting men who are with us, and not even one of them is missing;
verses.31:50: and we have brought the gift for the Lord, whatever gold article each man found, bangle and bracelet and ring and armband and braided ornament, to make atonement for us before the Lord."
verses.31:51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, every crafted article.
verses.31:52: And all the gold, the set-apart offering that they set apart for the Lord, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the commanders of thousands and from the commanders of hundreds.
verses.31:53: And the fighting men plundered, each for himself.
verses.31:54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the commanders of thousands and from the commanders of hundreds, and brought it into the tent of testimony, a memorial of the sons of Israel before the Lord.
verses.32:1: Now the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad had a multitude of livestock, a very great multitude; and they saw the region of Jazer and the region of Gilead, and the place was a place for livestock.
verses.32:2: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad approached and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
verses.32:3: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sibmah, Nebo, and Beon,
verses.32:4: the land which the Lord has delivered over before the sons of Israel, is a land for raising livestock, and your servants have livestock."
verses.32:5: And they said, "If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your household servants as a possession, and do not bring us across the Jordan."
verses.32:6: And Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, "Are your brothers going to war, and will you sit here?
verses.32:7: And why are you turning aside the minds of the sons of Israel, so that they do not cross over into the land which the Lord is giving to them?
verses.32:8: Did not your fathers act in this way when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land?
verses.32:9: And they went up to the Valley of the Cluster, and inspected the land, and turned away the heart of the sons of Israel, so that they would not enter into the land which the Lord gave to them.
verses.32:10: And the Lord became angry with fury on that day, and swore, saying,
verses.32:11: 'Surely these men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, who know evil and good, will not see the land which He swore to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, for they did not follow closely after Me,
verses.32:12: except Caleb son of Jephunneh, the one set apart, and Joshua the son of Nun, because he followed closely after the Lord.'
verses.32:13: And the Lord became angry with fury against Israel, and made them wander around in the wilderness forty years, until the entire generation was consumed, those who were doing evil before the Lord.
verses.32:14: Look, you have risen up in place of your fathers, a band of sinful men, to add still more to the fury of the anger of the Lord against Israel;
verses.32:15: for you will turn away from Him, so as once more to leave it in the wilderness, and you will act lawlessly against this whole congregation."
verses.32:16: And they approached him and said, "Let us build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our dependents,
verses.32:17: and we ourselves will arm as a vanguard ahead of the sons of Israel, until we bring them to their own place; and our dependents will dwell in walled cities because of those who dwell in the land.
verses.32:18: We will by no means return to our houses until the sons of Israel have been apportioned, each one to his inheritance.
verses.32:19: And we will no longer inherit among them from across the Jordan and beyond, because we have received our allotments across the Jordan on the east."
verses.32:20: And Moses said to them, "If you do according to this word, if you arm yourselves before the Lord for war,
verses.32:21: and every armed man among you crosses over the Jordan before the Lord until His enemy is wiped out from His presence
verses.32:22: and the land is subdued before the Lord, then afterward you will return, and you will be guiltless before the Lord and toward Israel, and this land will be yours as a possession before the Lord.
verses.32:23: But if you do not do so, you will sin before the Lord, and you will know your sin when evils overtake you.
verses.32:24: And build for yourselves cities for your dependents and folds for your livestock, and what goes out from your mouth, this you shall do."
verses.32:25: And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad spoke to Moses, saying, "Your servants will do just as our lord will command.
verses.32:26: Our dependents, our wives, and all our livestock will be in the cities of Gilead;
verses.32:27: but your servants will cross over, all armed and arrayed before the Lord for the war, just as our lord says."
